title: Director, Corporate Communications
description: <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm, working with the world’s leading companies to solve their most complex business challenges. We provide strategic counsel across communications, investor relations, financial transactions, restructuring, geopolitics, public affairs, management consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory and people advisory.</p> <p>With more than 50 offices worldwide, Teneo partners with CEOs, boards and senior executives to help organisations earn trust, navigate disruption and deliver against their strategic objectives.</p> <h3>The Opportunity</h3> <p>Teneo is seeking a high-calibre Director to join our team in Berlin or Frankfurt. This is a senior, client-facing role with a focus on corporate communication and reputation.</p> <h3>Role Overview</h3> <p>As a Director in Teneo Strategy &amp; Communications business in Europe, you will be responsible for building trusted senior client relationships, leading complex client mandates in collaboration with (Senior) Managing Director and contributing to the growth and reputation of the business.</p> <p>Based in Berlin or Frankfurt, you will work closely with Teneo colleagues across Europe and the global network to deliver integrated advice to clients. This will include collaboration with specialists in corporate reputation, crisis preparedness and response, public affairs, geopolitics, management consulting, risk advisory, people advisory, sustainability, digital and creative campaigning.</p> <p>This role requires both strategic advisory excellence and a strong commercial mindset. The successful candidate will be expected to bring market credibility, senior relationships, origination capability and the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams through complex, high-profile and often sensitive client situations.</p> <h3>Key Responsibilities</h3> <h3>Client Counsel</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Act as trusted adviser to clients across a diversity of sectors and industries.</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Provide leadership on corporate narrative, reputation, stakeholder engagement, issues management and crisis preparedness.</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Advise clients on how to communicate effectively with employees, media, government, regulators, customers, investors, partners and other key stakeholders.</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Bring judgement, discretion and confidence to high-pressure situations involving complex stakeholder dynamics, significant public scrutiny and reputational risk.</h3> <h3>Corporate Communications and Crisis Situations</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Develop communications strategies around major corporate events, business transformation, leadership change, restructuring, litigation, regulatory scrutiny, operational incidents, cyber incidents, activism and other significant or sensitive situations.</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Advise clients on crisis preparedness, scenario planning, crisis governance, response strategies, messaging and stakeholder engagement.</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Work closely with legal advisers, public affairs teams, risk specialists, management consultants and other advisers to ensure communications strategies are aligned with broader business objectives and stakeholder considerations.</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Provide leadership in fast-moving and high-pressure situations involving intense scrutiny, competing stakeholder expectations and significant reputational risk.</h3> <h3>Media, Reputation and Stakeholder Management</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Develop and execute media strategies involving German, European and international business, corporate and national media.</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Advise clients on reputation management, corporate positioning, proactive storytelling, executive positioning, crisis situations and complex issues.</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Help organisations build and protect trust with their most important stakeholders through clear, credible and consistent communications.</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Provide senior counsel on emerging reputational risks, stakeholder expectations and issues that may affect corporate licence to operate.</h3> <h3>Leadership</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Leading project teams to develop and deliver communications that have real impact for our clients&nbsp;</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Providing team direction and management whilst acting as the day to day point of contact for clients</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Challenging the status quo with new thinking, new product development, and new ways of working&nbsp;</h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Responsible for leading client servicing, profitability, forecasting and budgeting&nbsp;</h3> <h3>o&nbsp;&nbsp; Proactively contributing to and fostering the development of junior team members</h3> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p><strong>Skills and Experience&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years’ experience of working in a senior role in corporate communications</li> <li>Prior experience in an advisory firm is a plus</li> <li>Demonstrable experience in managing project teams&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent understanding of media, social media, and stakeholder environments</li> <li>Excellent ability to shape and deliver strategic advice to senior level clients&nbsp;</li> <li>Able to manage and mentor junior staff&nbsp;</li> <li>An engaging self-starter with high attention to detail&nbsp;</li> <li>Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills&nbsp;</li> <li>A collaborator who is able to foster good working relationships&nbsp;</li> <li>Time management and the ability to prioritise a varied workload&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfortable taking the lead on driving performance and revenue&nbsp;</li> <li>Native level German required</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p><strong>About Teneo</strong></p> <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.</p> <p>Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.</p> <p>Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&amp;I.</p> <p>The firm has more than 2,000 employees located in 50+ offices around the world.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior SEM Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><span class="fabric-text-color-mark" data-renderer-mark="true" data-text-custom-color="#0747a6"><u data-renderer-mark="true">THE ROLE </u></span></strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2301" data-local-id="6d5afd27-5970-45c1-b675-f5df64663cbf"><strong>Senior SEM Manager</strong></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2320" data-local-id="f6597815-fb6f-48c2-a22a-55ab8b3f15f3">We’re looking for a Senior SEM Manager to run Paid Search execution across our European launch markets, reporting to the Director of SEM. Our buyers rarely arrive knowing they have a problem worth solving, so you win through deep discovery, a sharp business case and trust built across several stakeholders.

You will write the playbook with us. Our OEM motion in DACH is still being built, and you will shape how we sell to it, with a founder and a VP of Sales next to you.

 

Your performance objectives

Generate pipeline

  • Create qualified pipeline of roughly €420k–€500k ARR per quarter at Level 2 and €570k–€680k at Level 3, through your own outbound, events and the meetings our BDRs book, qualified with SPICED (Situation, Pain, Impact, Critical event, Decision criteria).

  • Build your network: connect with 50+ relevant decision-makers at electronics manufacturers per quarter and represent Luminovo at 2–3 industry fairs a year.

  • Ramp with clear targets: in your first 3 months, complete the discovery and demo certifications and all Lumiversity courses, and create 4 qualified opportunities at Level 2 or 6 at Level 3 (6 and 9 with BDR support). In your second quarter you work toward 50% of full quota, and from there toward full quota.

Close opportunities

  • Run demos tailored to each customer's pain and prove value with domain experts in workshops that quantify ROI: savings against market prices, risk exposure uncovered, disruptions avoided.

  • Guide prospects through complex buyer journeys: map stakeholders, handle procurement and legal, close about €105k–€125k of new ARR per quarter at Level 2 or €143k–€169k at Level 3, and hand over smoothly to Customer Success.

Build your OEM playbook

  • Within 6 months, document what works in the DACH OEM segment (messaging, discovery questions, objections) and contribute it to our sales playbook.

  • Feed customer and market insight to Product every month, with at least one concrete product input that lands on the roadmap.

Lead by example

  • Own your metrics (pipeline health, conversion, deal velocity) and use them to hit your quarterly targets.

  • Mentor our BDRs through call reviews and shared discovery, and ask for coaching after every major customer interaction.

 

Your potential growth path

  • Months 1–6: master the product, close your first 5–10 deals, build your DACH network.

  • Months 6–18: take on larger deals and complex stakeholder setups, mentor BDRs.

  • 18+ months: move into Enterprise AE (€100k+ deals), own strategic accounts, mentor junior AEs.

 

Your territory and work setup

German-speaking market (DACH) plus some English-speaking territories. Discovery, demos and negotiations happen in German and the company works in English, so you need both at a professional level. Hybrid at our Munich HQ or Berlin hub, with the sales team in the office three days a week. Occasional travel for retreats and industry events, costs covered.

 

Whom you'll be working with

  • Clifton Lobo, VP Global Sales, your manager, who coaches you on deal strategy and career progression

  • Sebastian Schaal, co-founder, for positioning and pricing

  • Inga Schwarz, Team Lead and pioneer AE for OEM, your partner in building the OEM playbook

  • Dasha and our BDR team, who feed you qualified meetings

  • Max Hungenbach and RevOps for CRM, dashboards and enablement

  • Marketing and Customer Success

 

Why Luminovo

  • Measurable product impact: our procurement intelligence shows OEMs where they pay above market and which parts put production at risk, so your business case starts from the customer's own BOMs

  • An open field: you shape the DACH OEM playbook with a founder and our VP Global Sales next to you

  • AI is part of how we work, from our MCP integrations to the agents our own teams build

  • Psychological safety, honest feedback, an international and remote-first team

 

Just so you know – we purposefully did not create a standard list of minimum qualifications for this role. We care much more about your motivation and ability to help us accelerate technical progress than we care just about your CV. We fundamentally believe that technology is the best tool that humankind has developed to tackle the biggest challenges we face as a society today. And we want to do our share in accelerating technological progress.

We bring innovations to life faster and cheaper by creating a more connected and resilient electronics supply chain.

title: Senior Controller:in (m/w/d)
description: HALLO wir suchen eine:n Senior Controller:in (m/w/d) , um bei Yazio einzusteigen und im Zuge unseres weiteren Wachstums die volle Verantwortung für unser Controlling zu übernehmen. Du bringst Struktur, Sorgfalt und fundiertes Fachwissen in unseren Monatsabschluss, die Buchhaltungsprozesse und die internen Kontrollen ein und setzt damit den Maßstab dafür, wie Controlling bei Yazio funktioniert. Mit rund 150 Mitarbeitenden wirken sich deine Entscheidungen zum Aufbau des Monatsabschlusses und zur Gestaltung der Buchhaltung langfristig aus. Diese bestimmen mit, wie das Finance-Team in den kommenden Jahren arbeitet. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, unsere zentralen Buchhaltungs- und Controlling-Prozesse kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln und zu verbessern. Du sorgst für korrekte und fristgerechte Finanzberichterstattung und bist die interne Anlaufstelle für fachliche Bilanzierungs- und Rechnungslegungsthemen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit FP&A, Legal, Operations und externen Partnern unterstützt du sowohl die operative Umsetzung im Tagesgeschäft als auch komplexe Bilanzierungsfragen zu neuen Produkten und Transaktionen. Diese Stelle ist zu 100 % remote und steht Bewerber:innen mit Wohnsitz in Deutschland, Spanien, Portugal oder dem Vereinigten Königreich offen. DEINE AUFGABEN Den Monatsabschluss von Anfang bis Ende aufbauen, verantworten und vorantreiben und gemeinsam mit Accounting und zentralen Stakeholdern eine schnelle, präzise und gut koordinierte Finanzberichterstattung sicherstellen Prüfung und Freigabe von Rückstellungen, Stichtagsbuchungen, Abstimmungen und Berichtspaketen für die Geschäftsleitung und den Bereich FP&A Als zentrale Anlaufstelle für Fragen zur Rechnungslegung fungieren und neue Geschäftsmodelle, Verträge sowie komplexe Bilanzierungssachverhalte unterstützen Technische Rechnungslegungsdokumentation und Positionspapiere entwickeln und pflegen (z. B. Umsatzrealisierung, Aktivierung, Leasingverhältnisse und andere komplexe Themen) Externe Partner wie Buchhalter:innen, Steuerberater:innen und Wirtschaftsprüfer:innen steuern und koordinieren und dabei für eine hohe Qualität der Dokumentation und eine reibungslose Zusammenarbeit sorgen Interne Kontrollen kontinuierlich stärken, indem du Auffälligkeiten erkennst, offene Punkte nachverfolgst und die Wirksamkeit der Kontrollen langfristig verbesserst Prozess- und Systemverbesserungen vorantreiben, um manuellen Aufwand zu reduzieren, die Effizienz im Abschlussprozess zu steigern und skalierbare, gut dokumentierte Workflows aufzubauen KI-Werkzeuge für Analysen, Abweichungserklärungen, Audit-Vorbereitung und Recherchen in der Rechnungslegung einsetzen und dabei die kritische Prüfung sowie die Verantwortung für die Ergebnisse übernehmen Eine moderne, skalierbare Finanzfunktion durch Automatisierung, Standardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung aufbauen DEIN PROFIL Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in Buchhaltung, Controlling oder Finanzberichterstattung, idealerweise in schnell wachsenden Unternehmen mit zunehmender Komplexität Vorerfahrung in der Leitung oder Koordination eines kleinen Buchhaltungsteams ist von Vorteil Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen HGB; IFRS-Erfahrung ist von Vorteil Nachweisliche Verantwortung für den gesamten Monatsabschluss, mit Blick auf Richtigkeit, Vollständigkeit und eine hohe Qualität der Berichterstattung Ausgeprägtes Verständnis für interne Kontrollen sowie die Fähigkeit, Risiken proaktiv zu erkennen, Kontrollen zu konzipieren und Prozesse kontinuierlich zu verbessern Fortgeschrittene DATEV-Kenntnisse und sicherer Umgang mit Buchhaltungssystemen und Finanzdaten Sicher im Umgang mit KI-Werkzeugen zur Steigerung der Produktivität (z. B. für Recherche, Dokumentation, Anomalieerkennung und Unterstützung bei der Berichterstattung), verbunden mit ausgeprägtem kritischen Urteilsvermögen bei der Bewertung der Ergebnisse Strukturierte, dokumentationsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit einem klaren Fokus auf Prüfbarkeit und Transparenz Ausgeprägter Wille zur Prozessverbesserung und ein gutes Gespür für Ineffizienzen und skalierbare Lösungen Nachweisliche Erfahrung im Umgang mit Stakeholdern und in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Buchhalter:innen, Steuerberater:innen und Wirtschaftsprüfer:innen Wachstumsorientiertes Mindset und die Bereitschaft, sich laufend über Änderungen in Rechnungslegung und Steuerrecht zu informieren (z. B. HGB, Umsatzsteuer und IFRS) WARUM WIR? Ein spannendes Produkt mit Millionen von Nutzer:innen in über 150 Ländern, angetrieben von unserer Mission, die Welt durch gesunde Ernährung zu verändern Ein Remote-First-Ansatz: Du arbeitest zu 100 % von zu Hause, nutzt einen Coworking-Space oder arbeitest für mehrere Wochen pro Jahr aus dem Ausland 30 Urlaubstage zum Entspannen und neue Energie tanken sowie 5 Kinderkrankentage, wenn dein Kind dich braucht Eine fokussierte Kultur, in der Effizienz wichtiger ist als lange Arbeitstage – keine Überstunden, und wenn doch, bekommst du die Zeit zurück! Ein Umfeld mit großer Wirkung, in dem deine Arbeit echte Veränderungen bewirkt – mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und ohne Mikromanagement Eine Teamkultur, in der Ehrgeiz und Balance Hand in Hand gehen, getragen von starker Verbundenheit – vom komplett bezahlten Unternehmens-Retreat bis hin zu Teamtreffen und virtuellen Kaffeepausen Tools und Support, damit du deine beste Arbeit leisten kannst: MacBook, Monitor und ein jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget von 1.000 €, plus regelmäßiges Feedback und Unterstützung bei deiner Karriereentwicklung Ein wirklich internationales Team mit Englisch als Unternehmenssprache und einem gemeinsamen Engagement für Wachstum und Wohlbefinden – unterstützt von Sunday Supplements und Nilo Health Vielfalt und Inklusion Bei YAZIO sind wir überzeugt, dass Vielfalt Innovation antreibt. Wir setzen uns für ein inklusives Umfeld ein, in dem sich alle wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlen, unabhängig von Geschlechtsidentität, ethnischer Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Behinderung. Wir schätzen unterschiedliche Perspektiven und ermutigen Menschen mit ganz verschiedenen Lebenswegen aktiv, sich bei uns zu bewerben. DU WILLST BEI UNS EINSTEIGEN? Du möchtest YAZIO aufs nächste Level bringen und Menschen weltweit zu einem gesünderen Leben verhelfen? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, von dir zu hören! Bitte sende uns: Deinen Lebenslauf auf Englisch Ein paar Zeilen (oder ein kurzes Video, falls dir das lieber ist) darüber, wer du bist und warum du bei YAZIO arbeiten möchtest Weitere Unterlagen, die deine Arbeit zeigen (z. test records Line reliability: Offline tolerance at the station, idempotent operations, safe deployments during production and fast incident response Testability: Clean architecture and emulators for recovery after failures API design: REST and OpenAPI, signed webhooks, versioning and backward compatibility with external suppliers MongoDB in depth: document modelling, schema versioning, indexing We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Senior Backend Engineer, Engineering & Manufacturing Systems to own the software behind our end-of-line testing. You own the service that orchestrates test plans across stations, talks to PLCs, scanners and measurement equipment, provisions every unit and records what was tested. Every product and variant we build passes through it, and when it stops, the line stops. This is not a classic application backend: your system sits between software, hardware and the shop floor.

Your roadmap to make an impact

  • Test orchestration: Own the service end to end: API, test plan engine, state machines for units, jobs and plans, persistence, events and deployment

  • Shop floor integration: Integrate PLCs, station middleware, 3D scanners and measurement and calibration equipment through robust interfaces with clear timeouts, retries and error handling

  • Iterative tests: Closed feedback loops between the test runtime and the station, such as calibration where the station controls timing and the service computes the next step

  • Products and variants: Model products, variants, test plans and tolerances so that new products and process changes become configuration, not code

  • Provisioning and records: Integrate PKI and ERP to provision every unit and produce signed, auditable test records

  • Line reliability: Offline tolerance at the station, idempotent operations, safe deployments during production and fast incident response

  • Testability: Clean architecture and emulators for stations and devices, so changes are proven before they reach the line

  • Observability: Structured logging, metrics and tracing that show what is wrong on the line before operators notice

  • On the floor: Work with production engineers, quality and station suppliers, and turn process changes into software quickly


  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of backend engineering in production

  • Expert Python: typing, asyncio, a modern web framework such as FastAPI, and pytest as a daily tool

  • Strong grasp of software architecture: clean architecture, hexagonal (ports and adapters) and domain-driven design, applied in real codebases

  • State machines and workflow orchestration for long-running processes, with idempotency, retries and consistent recovery after failures

  • API design: REST and OpenAPI, signed webhooks, versioning and backward compatibility with external suppliers

  • MongoDB in depth: document modelling, schema versioning, indexing and migrations on live data

  • Security in production systems: certificate signing flows, mTLS and API authentication

  • Observability and operations: OpenTelemetry or similar, alerting, incident response; Docker and Kubernetes on premises or at the edge

  • Fluent in English; German is a plus on the shop floor

Beneficial

  • Experience with systems that talk to hardware or the shop floor: manufacturing test, MES, industrial automation or lab automation

  • Industrial integration: OPC UA, Modbus TCP or comparable PLC interfaces, plus serial and Ethernet device communication

  • MES, traceability and genealogy in manufacturing

  • Test executive frameworks such as NI TestStand or OpenHTF

  • Calibration and metrology processes

Daraus entwickelst du Zielprozesse, die über Teams und Länder hinweg funktionieren. AI-First: Für jeden Prozessschritt entscheidest du: streichen, vereinfachen, an AI übergeben oder automatisieren. Du schreibst die Anforderungen für unsere AI- und Automation-Kolleg:innen und testest, was sie liefern. Standards & Ownership: Mit den Leads legst du Prozessstandards fest und benennst klare Process Owner. So wird Continuous Improvement Teil des Alltags. Projekte: Projekte rund um Prozesse, Rollen und Change leitest du selbst. Bei technischen Projekten bist du von Anfang an dabei und gestaltest die Prozessseite mit. Aufbauarbeit: Als erste Person mit vollem Prozessfokus legst du die Grundlagen. Du entscheidest mit, mit welchen Methoden und Templates wir arbeiten und wie wir Projekte aufsetzen und übergeben. Inspire us by Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Prozess- oder Operations-Beratung, Operational Excellence, Business Process Management oder einer operativen Rolle mit Prozessverantwortung. The Team

Our Technology Transformation practice is helping organizations all over the world transform their operating model to succeed in the new normal – scaling up digitization and cloud transformation programs, optimizing costs, and accelerating value realization. Our solutions focus on the big-ticket value items on the C-Suite agenda, providing a deep link between business and IT to help you lead with influence beyond the back-office remit. For more information and details on the services we provide and the clients we serve, please visit or careers page.

The role

As a Service Designer at Infosys Consulting, you help our clients understand what their customers really need and turn those insights into services that work seamlessly across every touchpoint – digital and physical, frontstage and backstage. You make the entire customer journey smooth and enjoyable for users and successful for the business, driving satisfaction, retention and long-term growth.

You bring a solid foundation in human-centered design, CX strategy and digital transformation, and you understand how service experiences connect to the client’s marketing, CRM, customer care and operations. Working directly with client stakeholders, you lay the groundwork for a holistic service and CX strategy, establish standards, processes and ways of working, and build the client’s own capability.

Key Responsibilities :

Service & CX Strategy

  • Define a service vision and CX strategy that delivers consistent, high-quality experiences across all channels and aligns with business objectives.
  • Translate business goals into service principles, experience goals and measurable KPIs (e.g. NPS, CSAT, CES, retention)
  • Map and re-orchestrate the service ecosystem along the customer life cycle using ecosystem maps and stakeholder maps
  • Develop service propositions and value propositions together with business owners
  • Define the roadmap of guidelines, trainings and key projects needed to realize the strategy
  • Shape the target operating model and team structure for service design and CX on the client side
  • Work with leadership to embed Service Design and Design Thinking in the company’s culture

Insight Management & Customer Understanding

  • Turn customer data, research and behavior into actionable insights in collaboration with research and analytics teams.
  • Synthesize qualitative and quantitative data into personas, jobs-to-be-done, mental models and insight statements
  • Use NPS, satisfaction and operational metrics to assess the current experience and spot patterns, trends and pain points
  • Present data-driven recommendations that improve retention and satisfaction
  • Set up an insight and requirements pipeline that continuously feeds product, channel and solution owners

Journey Mapping & Service Blueprinting

  • Make the end-to-end service visible and design how it should work in future – for customers, employees and systems.
  • Facilitate as-is customer journey maps and service blueprints across channels, including frontstage, backstage and supporting processes
  • Identify moments of truth, breakpoints and improvement opportunities online and offline
  • Design to-be journeys and blueprints across multiple applications as well as in depth for specific services
  • Connect journey and blueprint work to process, organizational and technology changes

Co-Creation, Ideation & Prototyping

  • Lead the double-diamond process from problem framing to tested solution together with clients and their customers.
  • Plan and facilitate co-creation workshops, design sprints and ideation sessions with cross-functional teams
  • Frame problems with How-Might-We questions, opportunity areas and design challenges
  • Create and test service prototypes – storyboards, service walkthroughs, desktop walkthroughs, role-play and click dummies
  • Run experiments and pilots, measure impact and iterate towards scalable solutions

Service Standards & Guidelines

  • Initiate and support standards that ensure high service quality across websites, native apps, phone, email, chat and in-person support.
  • Create service design playbooks, journey and blueprint libraries, persona sets and design principles
  • Establish service standards, benchmarks and end-to-end testing approaches
  • Set up quality assurance processes to monitor and evaluate customer interactions

Requirements

  • Degree in Service Design, Interaction/UX Design, Design Management, Business, Psychology or a related field
  • Consultant: 3–5 years of experience in service design, CX or UX, ideally in consulting or an in-house design team
  • Senior Consultant: 5–8 years of experience, including leading projects and client workstreams
  • Hands-on command of core service design methods: stakeholder and ecosystem mapping, personas, customer journey mapping, service blueprinting, co-creation and service prototyping
  • Experience with design research (interviews, contextual inquiry, observation, diary studies) and synthesis (affinity mapping, insight clustering)
  • Ability to link customer insight with business objectives, KPIs and business cases
  • Strong workshop facilitation and stakeholder management skills, from operational teams to C-level
  • Confident with collaboration and visualisation tools such as Miro, Mural, Figma or similar
  • Ability to integrate AI tools throughout every stage of the design process, from research and insight generation to ideation, prototyping, testing, and service optimization, enhancing both efficiency and innovation.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills in both GERMAN and ENGLISH

Preferred/Desirable experience

  • Experience in CX strategy and digital transformation programmes
  • Knowledge of adjacent areas on the client side: marketing, CRM and loyalty, customer care and contact centres
  • Experience designing omnichannel services that combine digital and physical touchpoints
  • Preferred tool proficiency: Miro, Figma, FigJam, Claude Code
  • Familiarity with CX metrics (NPS, CSAT, CES) and Voice-of-Customer programmes
  • Exposure to agile delivery, Lean UX and product operating models
  • Experience applying AI and GenAI in services or CX operations
  • Experience building design capabilities, playbooks or design systems at client organisations
  • Industry experience in e.g. retail, automotive, financial services, telecommunications, utilities or the public sector
  • Certification in Design Thinking, Service Design (e.g. SDN) or agile methods

Level differentiation

Consultant: delivers service design work within a project, applies methods confidently and facilitates workshops with guidance

Senior Consultant: owns workstreams and client relationships, shapes the approach, coaches junior team members and contributes to proposals and business development

Given that this is just a short snapshot of the role we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements listed above. We are looking for individuals who strive to make an impact and are eager to learn. If this sounds like you and you feel you have the skills and experience required, then please apply now.

Benefits

Be part of a globally renowned management consulting firm on the front-line of industry disruption and at the cutting edge of technology.  We work with market leading brands across sectors. Our culture is inclusive and entrepreneurial. Being a mid-size consultancy within the scale of Infosys gives us the global reach to partner with our clients throughout their transformation journey.

Our core values, IC-LIFE, form a common code that helps us move forward. IC-LIFE stands for Inclusion, Equity and Diversity, Client, Leadership, Integrity, Fairness, and Excellence. To learn more about Infosys Consulting and our values, please visit our .

We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.&nbsp; Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.</p> <p>We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes’ health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. You’ll develop backend services and frontend features that help football clubs explore our data, evaluate players and teams, and analyse performance. Your work will span data-rich interfaces, interactive visualisations, integrated video tools, and workflows that support scouting and match analysis. Working closely with Product and fellow engineers, you’ll translate customer needs into intuitive, reliable applications and help improve their performance and scalability as our platform grows. As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you’ll contribute to technical decisions and take ownership of features from initial design through to delivery, shaping the products our customers use every day.</p> <p>We believe that our customers deserve to have the leading technology, and we are on a mission to make the best possible products to enhance their performance.&nbsp; Our engineers drive this ethos by making sure all of this technology comes together in a way our customers love to use.</p> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Contribute to the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, design, implementation, testing, and deployment.</li> <li>Build and maintain Angular web applications</li> <li>Build and maintain Java Spring Boot APIs and backend services that power our applications</li> <li>Design and implement database schema</li> <li>Profile and optimize query performance in backend applications</li> <li>Engage in architectural discussions to help design scalable and resilient systems.</li> <li>Work directly with Product and Design on scoping and designing features</li> <li>Work in multidisciplinary teams and interface with other engineers in our team and across various domains.</li> <li>Document your work in a shared knowledge base platform.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHAT YOU’LL NEED</strong></h3> <ul> <li>At least 5 years of software development experience.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience programming in Typescript, Javascript, and Angular</li> <li>Demonstrated experience programming in Kotlin Java.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience working in SQL and designing database schema</li> <li>Ability to reason about and debug complex systems and applications</li> <li>Experience with Git code management is highly desired.</li> </ul> <p>Other Requirements:</p> <ul> <li>Very strong attention to detail.</li> <li>Proven self-starter.</li> <li>Ability to communicate well, both verbally and in writing.</li> <li>Ability to prioritise and a “can-do” attitude.</li> <li>Occasionally providing technical assistance to our customer support team</li> </ul> <h3><strong>WHY CATAPULT?&nbsp;</strong></h3> <ul> <li>We have amazing people. We can promise you will work with some of the most ambitious and intelligent people in an exciting industry, and you will do some of the best work of your life.</li> <li>We encourage our people to have constructive, open and honest communication in order to make Catapult extraordinary; innovate and create smart solutions; establish a collaborative, yet challenging, environment to develop our performance and the performance of our customers.</li> <li>Our workforce spans more than 20 countries, you'll have the opportunity to work across multiple nationalities and cultures, and build your global awareness and capability&nbsp;</li> <li>We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to do things better.&nbsp; There is unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better.</li> </ul> <p>Whether you’re interested in sports or not, you’ll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet!&nbsp;</p> <p>Research shows that while men apply for jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized groups tend only to apply when they check every box. So if you have what it takes, but don't meet every single point in our job ad, please still get in touch! We would love to have a chat and see if you could be a great addition to our team. We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do.</p> <p>All offers of employment are subject to Catapult's positive prehire check. To find out more, please contact the Talent Partner for this role.</p> <p><br><br></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

raw.title: Engineering Manager, Demand (f/m/d)
raw.description:
About us

Zenjob is an AI-powered flexible staffing platform that has efficiently connected companies and temporary workers since 2015. Companies use our platform to book ready-to-work staff in real time, while students use our app to find part-time jobs that conveniently fit around their studies. Over 40,000 students and 1,000 partner companies from logistics, retail, and hospitality in all major German cities share our belief that good work is not a coincidence. It is the result of innovative technology and genuine commitment. Good work starts here.

The role

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Demand engineering team – the team that owns the company side of our marketplace. Your team of 5–7 engineers builds everything B2B-facing: the products our customers use to place and manage their staffing orders, and the integrations that connect Zenjob to the vendor management systems (VMSs) they rely on.

You'll partner closely with your product counterpart. This is a player-coach role: we're looking for someone who leads through people but stays close enough to the code to guide architecture decisions, unblock the team, and keep the technical bar high.

What you'll do

  • Lead, coach, and grow a cross-functional team of full-stack engineers – owning their development, engagement, and performance

  • Own delivery for the Demand team: shape the roadmap with your product partners, break down complex initiatives, and ensure the team ships predictably and with quality

  • Engage deeply with the product: question assumptions, challenge proposals, and bring ideas of your own – constructively, and always with the business impact in mind

  • Embrace how AI keeps reshaping engineering as a craft: advocate for the increased autonomy these tools bring, and support your team by role-modelling their usage

  • Stay hands-on: guide system design and architecture decisions, review code where it matters, and contribute when it accelerates the team

  • Drive operational excellence – monitoring, incident response, and continuous improvement of the team's engineering practices

  • Hire and onboard engineers as the team evolves, and contribute to engineering-wide initiatives beyond your team

  • Collaborate with other Engineering Managers and stakeholders across Product and Commercial (Sales and Account Management) to align the demand side of the marketplace with company goals

What you bring

  • Several years of experience leading software engineers as a people manager, ideally in a product-led or marketplace environment

  • A strong technical foundation: you've worked as a senior engineer yourself and can still credibly engage on architecture, code, and technical trade-offs

  • Comfort with our stack: we build in TypeScript across both backend and frontend, with some older services still in Java and Groovy

  • A product mindset: you care about outcomes over output and know how to connect engineering work to user and business impact

  • Experience growing engineers across levels – coaching, feedback, and performance management hold no secrets for you

  • Pragmatism in balancing delivery speed, quality, and maintainability

  • Fluent English (our company language); German is a plus

Engineering at Zenjob

Our product engineering teams are cross-functional and full-stack, each owning one of the business domains our marketplace is built around – Supply, Staffing, and Demand. We build in TypeScript across both backend and frontend, with some older services still in Java and Groovy.

We run a pragmatic engineering culture: outcomes over output, ownership over process, and direct feedback over comfortable silence. Engineers are expected to engage with the product, not just implement it. And we're leaning into how AI is changing the way software gets built – we invest in the tools and expect everyone, managers included, to use them and push what they make possible.

What we offer

  • Innovative mission: Together we create something new. Work in a dynamic set-up where you learn a lot and your every idea is heard.

  • Unique team spirit: We can rely on each other blindly and celebrate all successes together as a team.

  • Vacation: Recreation and further education is important, which is why we offer 28 days of paid vacation (increased by 1 day for every 2 calendar years of service with us, up to a maximum of 30 days), 1 day of special leave for community service, 5 days of paid educational leave, and the possibility of unpaid leave

  • Hybrid working model: We love our brand new office in Prenzlauer Berg. But sometimes you need a little more flexibility. Zenjob’s flexible working model combines the best of both worlds, so you can work remotely up to 2 days / week (1 day, during the first 6 months, so we can guarantee you the best onboarding).

  • Dog-lover: If you have a dog, feel free to bring it with you. We don’t bite and always have a bowl of water in our range of drinks

  • Personal growth: Ongoing focus on your personal development (annual training budget of EUR 1000, mentoring opportunities, constant career development conversations)

  • Healthy mind in a healthy body: With us you will receive a 30 EUR Urban Sports Club grant to keep you fit. In addition, we have a small sports room in the office ourselves.

  • Always mobile: You will receive EUR 40 credit per month for NAVIT, a sustainable mobility tool for public transport, bike sharing and much more.

  • Legendary Events: Quarterly team events, winter and summer parties, budget for birthdays and anniversaries of our employees

If this sounds good, then we’d love to find out more about you! Apply and send in your application.

🎥 Watch our Office Tour video.

We invite you to visit our careers page, follow our LinkedIn page and connect with us on Instagram.

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to judging every qualified individual on their ability, regardless of age, gender identity, ethnicity, sexual orientation, disability status, or religion. There is no need to add your photo and age to the application.

title: Geschäftsführer (m/f/d)
description: Über Buena Buena baut die Technologie, auf der die Immobilienbranche läuft. Wir machen jeden Teil der Immobilienwirtschaft so nahtlos und transparent wie möglich - vom Finden über das Finanzieren bis zum Verwalten. Dafür übernehmen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und bauen sie zu Technologieunternehmen um. In unter zwei Jahren und mit weniger als 25 Leuten im HQ sind wir bereits Deutschlands zweitgrößter Immobilienverwalter geworden. Über die Rolle Ab Tag eins liegt die Geschäftsführung und operative Gesamtverantwortung für eine Hausverwaltung am Standort Kassel in deinen Händen. Der Hauptfokus liegt dabei auf der Führung des Teams vor Ort, der kontinuierlichen Optimierung operativer Abläufe sowie der aktiven Mitgestaltung des Tagesgeschäfts. Als erfahrene Führungskraft repräsentierst du das Unternehmen gegenüber Kunden und garantierst eine erstklassige Verwaltungsqualität. Gemeinsam mit uns sicherst du nachhaltigen Erfolg und setzt neue Standards in der Branche. Deine Aufgaben Geschäftsführung einer Hausverwaltung und Verantwortung für das Tagesgeschäft der Niederlassung in Kassel inklusive Budget-, Kosten- und GuV-Verantwortung sowie Qualitätssicherung. Souveräne Leitung von Eigentümerversammlungen (ETVs) sowie professionelle Betreuung von Beiräten und Eigentümern. Fachliche und disziplinarische Führung, Steuerung und Motivation des bestehenden Teams vor Ort sowie Verantwortung für den weiteren Personalaufbau. Deine Rolle In deiner Rolle als Praktikant im Bereich Finance Operations bildest du das verlässliche Rückgrat unseres Finanzteams. Du steuerst die kompletten Abläufe der Kreditorenbuchhaltung, begleitest aktiv die Einführung frischer Systeme sowie Abläufe und agierst als maßgebliche Schnittstelle zu externen Steuerberatern. Gleichzeitig garantierst du reibungslose, strukturierte Prozesse in unseren Tochterunternehmen. An der Seite von Finance Lead und CFO erhältst du umfassende Einblicke in sämtliche Finanzstrukturen, vom einzelnen Beleg bis zur strategischen Liquiditätssteuerung. Was du tun wirst Accounts Payable: Du managst unseren Eingangsrechnungs-Workflow von A bis Z – Postkorb, Invoice Chasing, Freigabeprozesse und Zahlungen ausführen. Sorgfalt und ein Auge für Details sind hier entscheidend. Buchungsqualität: Du stellst sicher, dass Rechnungen mit den richtigen Konten, Kostenstellen und Steuersätzen erfasst werden. Du bist die erste Instanz, bevor Buchungen zu unseren Steuerberatern gehen, und unterstützt bei buchhalterischen Rückfragen. Tochtergesellschaften: Du überprüfst regelmäßig die BWAs unserer Töchter, erkennst Abweichungen und Unplausibilitäten und stellst sicher, dass vorgegebene Prozesse konsequent eingehalten werden. Zudem begleitest du den Rollout in unseren Tochtergesellschaften, schulst die Teams vor Ort und gewährleistest eine hohe Datenqualität und Vollständigkeit. Du passt gut zu uns, wenn Du Ownership liebst und nicht wartest, bis jemand anderes eine Rechnung sucht, einen Fehler korrigiert oder einen Prozess aufräumt – du siehst es, du löst es. Sind Sie bereit, Ihre berufliche Zukunft in die Hand zu nehmen? Willkommen bei reboVet!

Stellen Sie sich vor, Sie arbeiten bei einem Unternehmen, das seit fast 50 Jahren die Bedürfnisse seiner Kunden versteht und zuverlässig erfüllt. Bei reboVet, einem der führenden Großhändler für Tierarztpraxen in Deutschland, bieten wir Ihnen ein Umfeld, in dem Ihre Weiterentwicklung und Ideen gefördert werden und spannende Projekte an der Tagesordnung stehen.

Mit einem beeindruckenden Sortiment von über 30.000 Produkten und einer tiefen Verbundenheit zu unseren Kunden setzen wir neue Maßstäbe. Gemeinsam entwickeln wir maßgeschneiderte Lösungen für Tierarztpraxen – und das macht uns zum Partner der Wahl. Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Karriere auf das nächste Level zu heben? Dann verstärken Sie unser Team und werden Sie Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte!

Kaufmann für IT-System-Management / IT-Systemkaufmann (m/w/d)

Sie möchten IT nicht nur verwalten, sondern aktiv mitgestalten?

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die technisches Verständnis mit kaufmännischem Denken verbindet und gemeinsam mit unseren Fachabteilungen unsere IT-Systeme und digitalen Prozesse im Tagesgeschäft am Laufen hält und stetig weiterentwickelt.

Aufgaben:

· Betreuung unserer Mitarbeitenden bei Fragen und Problemen rund um Hard- und Software sowie deren Schulung

· Einrichtung und Administration von Arbeitsplätzen, Benutzerkonten und mobilen Endgeräten

· Betreuung unserer Microsoft-365-Umgebung

· Unterstützung bei Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung sowie Störungen unseres ERP-Systems sowie weiterer Fachanwendungen

· Aufnahme, Analyse und Umsetzung von Anforderungen aus den Fachabteilungen

· Koordination externer IT-Dienstleister und Softwareanbieter

· Beschaffung von Hard- und Software sowie Verwaltung von Lizenzen

· Prüfung und Bewertung von Angeboten und IT-Dienstleistungen

· Mitarbeit bei IT-Projekten, Systemeinführungen, Updates und Migrationen

· Analyse und Optimierung bestehender Geschäfts- und IT-Prozesse

· Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung von Schnittstellen zwischen unseren Systemen

· Erstellung und Pflege von System- und Prozessdokumentationen

· Unterstützung bei den Themen IT-Sicherheit, Datenschutz, Berechtigungen und Datensicherung

Das Profil, das zu uns passt:

· Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Kaufmann/-frau für IT-System-Management, IT-Systemkaufmann/-frau, Fachinformatiker/in oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

· Gute Kenntnisse im Microsoft-Umfeld

· Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung

· Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365 / Active Directory

· Grundverständnis für Netzwerke, Clients, Benutzer- und Rechteverwaltung

· Erfahrung mit Warenwirtschaftssystemen (ERP) oder Lagerverwaltungssystemen

· Kaufmännisches Verständnis

· Fähigkeit, technische Sachverhalte verständlich zu erklären

Wünschenswert:

· Erfahrung mit Schnittstellen und Datenaustausch zwischen verschiedenen Systemen

· Grundkenntnisse SQL bzw. Datenbanken

· Erfahrung im Lizenzmanagement

· Kenntnisse im IT-Projektmanagement

· Kenntnisse zu IT-Sicherheit und Datenschutz

Wir bieten:

Bei uns übernehmen Sie nicht nur klassischen IT-Support. Sie wirken aktiv an der Digitalisierung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Unternehmensprozesse mit und arbeiten dabei eng mit den Fachabteilungen, der Geschäftsleitung sowie externen IT- und Softwarepartnern zusammen.

  • Eine lange Erfolgsgeschichte: Seit 45 Jahren bewahren wir unsere Werte und Traditionen und haben gleichzeitig den Blick fest auf die Zukunft gerichtet.
  • Entscheidungsmöglichkeiten: Flache Hierarchien ermöglichen es Ihnen, schnell Einfluss zu nehmen und Dinge voranzutreiben.
  • Gemeinsame Arbeit, gemeinsame Erfolge: In einem kollegialen Umfeld arbeiten wir Hand in Hand, um unsere Ziele zu erreichen und Erfolge zu feiern.
  • Ihre Stimme zählt: Wir schätzen Feedback und bieten Ihnen die Möglichkeit, sich in einer offenen Kultur ständig weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Betriebliche Krankenversicherung: Sie profitieren von einer vollständig Arbeitgeber-finanzierten betrieblichen Krankenzusatzversicherung.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Sie profitieren von einer vom Arbeitgeber teilfinanzierten Altersvorsorge.
  • Mehr als Arbeit: Nutzen Sie Corporate Benefits für exklusive Angebote und genießen Sie die Flexibilität, unter bestimmten Bedingungen Ihren Hund mit ins Büro zu bringen.


Bewerbungen bitte über den „Jetzt Bewerben-Button“.

Wir freuen uns darauf, von Ihnen zu hören!

title: Webdesigner-/Entwickler – WordPress & AI (m/w/d)
description: Web Developer – WordPress & AI (m/w/d) Du denkst digital, liebst Technologie und findest, dass KI erst der Anfang ist? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen. Wir sind ANY Marketing – eine junge, dynamische Digitalagentur und Teil der The Radio Group. Während andere Radio machen, machen wir Radio und denken digital weiter. Wir entwickeln moderne Websites, individuelle Softwarelösungen, eigene Tools und KI-gestützte Anwendungen. Dabei verbinden wir Kreativität, Technologie und künstliche Intelligenz mit der Reichweite und den Möglichkeiten eines Medienunternehmens. Unser Alltag? Alles außer Standard. Heute eine Website für den Bäcker um die Ecke, morgen ein digitales Projekt für einen Großkonzern und übermorgen vielleicht eine eigene Softwarelösung, die es so noch gar nicht gibt. Dafür suchen wir dich! Was dich bei uns erwartet Du konzipierst und entwickelst moderne, individuelle Websites auf Basis von WordPress und Breakdance. Du entwickelst eigene WordPress-Plugins, Schnittstellen und individuelle Funktionalitäten. Du nutzt KI-Tools aktiv in deinem Entwicklungsalltag und entdeckst neue Möglichkeiten, Prozesse intelligenter und effizienter zu gestalten. Du begleitest digitale Kundenprojekte von der ersten Idee bis zum Go-live. Du arbeitest an unseren eigenen digitalen Produkten, Plattformen und innovativen Anwendungen mit. Du stehst im direkten Austausch mit unseren Kunden, verstehst ihre Anforderungen und entwickelst passende Lösungen. Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse und probierst neue Technologien aus. Was du mitbringen solltest Du hast bereits praktische Erfahrung mit WordPress – und zwar über die reine Inhaltspflege hinaus. HTML, CSS, JavaScript und PHP sind für dich keine Fremdwörter. Du hast erste Erfahrungen mit KI-gestützter Entwicklung gesammelt, beispielsweise mit Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT oder vergleichbaren Tools. Du hast ein Gespür für moderne Websites, gutes Design, Performance und Benutzerfreundlichkeit. Du arbeitest eigenständig, lösungsorientiert und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung. Du bist kommunikativ und hast keine Scheu vor dem direkten Kundenkontakt. Du bist neugierig auf neue Technologien und hast Lust, dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Nice to have, aber kein Muss: Erfahrung mit Breakdance oder vergleichbaren modernen WordPress-Buildern Erfahrung in der Entwicklung eigener WordPress-Plugins Kenntnisse in Next.js, React oder anderen modernen Webtechnologien Erfahrung mit APIs, Automatisierungen und KI-Agenten Kenntnisse in Git, Hosting und Deployment Du musst nicht alles können. Viel wichtiger ist uns, dass du Lust hast, Neues zu lernen, Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen. Was wir dir bieten KI-first statt KI irgendwann: Bei uns ist künstliche Intelligenz kein Zukunftsthema, sondern gelebter Arbeitsalltag. Abwechslung garantiert: Spannende Projekte vom lokalen Handwerksbetrieb bis zum Großkonzern. Homeoffice: Flexibles Arbeiten, das zu deinem Alltag passt. Kurze Entscheidungswege: Weniger Bürokratie, mehr Umsetzung. Echte Kundennähe: Du erlebst unmittelbar, welchen Unterschied deine Arbeit macht. Raum für deine Ideen: Wir wollen nicht nur, dass du Aufgaben abarbeitest, sondern dass du mitgestaltest. Moderne Technologien: Die Möglichkeit, neue Tools, Frameworks und KI-Anwendungen auszuprobieren und produktiv einzusetzen. Ein außergewöhnliches Arbeitsumfeld: Als Teil der The Radio Group arbeitest du mitten in der Medienwelt – zwischen Radiostudios, kreativen Köpfen, digitalen Innovationen und spannenden Persönlichkeiten. Ein Team auf Augenhöhe: Offener Austausch, gemeinsames Lernen und Spaß an dem, was wir tun. Perspektive: Gestalte mit uns den wachsenden digitalen Geschäftsbereich einer Mediengruppe aktiv mit. Dein Lebenslauf ist nicht dein Code. Ob du studiert hast, eine Ausbildung abgeschlossen hast oder dir das Entwickeln selbst beigebracht hast, ist für uns zweitrangig. Entscheidend ist, was du kannst, wie du denkst und wohin du dich entwickeln möchtest. Zeig uns gerne, woran du bereits gearbeitet hast, welche Projekte dich begeistern oder wie du KI in deinem Alltag einsetzt. Wir wollen Menschen kennenlernen, keine perfekten Bewerbungsunterlagen. Let's build something great. Du hast Lust, gemeinsam mit uns die digitale Zukunft eines Medienunternehmens zu gestalten? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen! ANY Marketing GmbH Ein Unternehmen der The Radio Group www.any-marketing.de Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

Für diese dynamische Wachstumsphase suchen wir engagierte Verstärkung in zentraler Funktion.

Deine Rolle

Als Werkstudent oder Praktikant im Bereich Product Management, Operations & International Expansion arbeitest du direkt mit den Gründern an den operativen Grundlagen unseres Wachstums.

Du begleitest den gesamten Weg eines Produkts: von der Suche nach geeigneten Rohstoffen und Lieferanten über Preisverhandlungen und Produktionsplanung bis hin zu Verpackung, Qualitätsmanagement und internationaler Markteinführung.

About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About the role

Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and much of that work is done by AI agents. Agents are only as good as the product around them: reliable data, well-designed APIs, and interfaces where our team can review, correct and approve what an agent proposes before real money and real shipments move.

As a Senior Product Engineer, you own business problems end to end. You talk to the people who use what you build, decide with Product what to solve, and ship the whole slice: data model, services, AI agents and the user interface. You work in a domain where prices and stock change daily, supplier data arrives in every possible format, and a wrong number costs money. You set the quality bar for the team and make the engineers around you better.

Tech stack

Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. You don't need to know all of it on day one. We use AI coding tools heavily and expect you to pick up whatever part of the stack the problem needs.

  • Own a business problem from first conversation to production and beyond, for example making supplier pricing reliable from ingestion all the way to the quote a salesperson sends.

  • Turn messy external data such as supplier price lists, datasheets and stock feeds into trustworthy data the rest of the business relies on.

  • Measure whether what you shipped works, including evaluating and monitoring LLM-driven workflows in production.

  • Lead technical decisions, write down the trade-offs, and mentor other engineers through code review, pairing and direct feedback.

  • Help us hire by running interviews and defining what good engineering looks like at Andercore.

In your first six months, you might

  • Build a pricing engine that scales with our growing assortment and number of markets, and serves correct prices to sales, and later directly to customers, in milliseconds.

  • Automate procurement: turn supplier price lists, quotes and order confirmations into structured data, and let AI agents handle the manual steps between our buyers and suppliers.

What you bring

  • At least 5 years of experience building and running software in production, with real users and real consequences when it fails.

  • Strong backend skills at production scale in Java or a comparable language such as Kotlin, C# or Go, and willingness to work in Java and Spring Boot. Experience designing distributed, event-driven systems, with a focus on data correctness and failure modes.

  • Solid command of PostgreSQL and hands-on experience with AWS.

  • Your depth is on the backend, but full-stack delivery is expected: you build frontends in TypeScript and React. You don't need to be a frontend specialist, but you can ship a good interface for the problem you own.

  • Product sense: you ask why before how, you talk to users, and you can turn a vague problem into a clear plan.

  • Experience in a fast-growing company, where priorities shift and you keep shipping while the business changes around you.

  • A track record of solving business problems, not only technical ones.

  • Experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks is a strong plus. Curiosity and good engineering judgment about them is a must.

  • You raise the level of the people around you, and you push back when something doesn't make sense.

title: Head of IT and Security
description: WHO WE ARE Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant. Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach. Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions. Tackle problems that don't exist elsewhere - Fusion sits at a rare intersection of deep-tech R&D, industrial procurement, government relations, and venture financing, so non-tech functions face challenges no other workplace can offer. YOUR IMPACT As our Head of IT & Security in Munich, you will own IT and security across all of our sites: reliable systems so our people can work quickly, protection for one of the most valuable bodies of fusion IP in Europe, and the evidence that our controls work. Set one service standard across sites, including for IT onboarding and offboarding. Keep security assurance separate from IT delivery. Report security risks, service performance and remediation progress to leadership using live system data. Own the ISMS, security policies, incident response and business continuity. Assign owners to security alerts and drive vulnerability remediation, including patching, through verified closure. Take accountability for NIS2 compliance and the path to ISO 27001 certification, with evidence ready for audits and due diligence. Get the full value from Google Workspace Enterprise, GCP and our security tools, and enforce device management, endpoint protection, SSO, MFA and access controls. Set physical security standards for site access, cameras, visitors, monitoring and escalation. Bring in specialist expertise early to assess site risks and verify controls through commissioning. Own the cyber configuration, identity integration and security logging of connected access-control and camera systems. Define and verify security controls for lab, test-data and operational technology systems, with clear handling of exceptions. Manage our IT and security partners, contracts, service levels and licences, and match spend to what we use and need. You have hands-on depth in Google Workspace, identity and device management, endpoint security, SIEM and networks, and can review a firewall rule or access policy yourself. You turn security risks, digital and physical, into practical controls and check that they work. You have managed teams, budgets and partners against clear priorities and measurable outcomes. Nice to have Experience with Google SecOps or another Google-centric security stack. Experience implementing NIS2 requirements. Experience with ERP, lab, test-data or operational technology systems. raw.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - German Speaking
raw.description:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a versatile and highly skilled German-speaking Forward Deployed Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will combine strong technical abilities with excellent communication skills, working directly with customers to ensure they maximize the value of HappyRobot’s AI platform. You will be involved in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing support, while also contributing to product development and innovation.


At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You’ll Do

  • Customer-Facing Engineering – Work closely with customers from onboarding to ongoing usage, helping them integrate and optimize our AI solutions.

  • Technical Development – Build new features, MVPs, and scalable solutions that directly impact customer outcomes.

  • Full-Stack Development – Utilize React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python to develop robust applications and tools.

  • AI/ML Applications – Design, implement, and iterate on AI/ML solutions, including LLM prompting, tuning of voices, and transcribers to optimize use cases.

  • Integration & APIs – Manage APIs and integrations with third-party systems to ensure seamless functionality for customers.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration – Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to deliver tailored solutions.

  • Iterative Problem-Solving – Continuously iterate and improve AI solutions based on customer feedback and evolving requirements.

  • Project Management – Prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality results.

Must Have

  • Strong full-stack experience: React, TypeScript, Node.js.

  • Hands-on proficiency in Python.

  • Experience building AI/ML applications, including LLM prompting and tuning.

  • Ability to manage APIs and integrate with third-party systems.

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.

  • Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles


Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

description: This is for the person who's looking for their next growth challenge in recruiting. You can close a hard search, you know how to talk to candidates who aren't looking, and your current role has started to feel a little too comfortable. At eleQtron, you can still help write our next chapter and decide how we get there. We build quantum computers, with about 130 people across Hamburg and Siegen. Most of the people we need are physicists, engineers and software specialists who are sought-after talent. We’re still shaping how eleQtron finds them, how it tells them why they should join, and how we evolve our approach to hiring. That's the job you can define. What you'll do You'll sit inside our technical teams as their talent partner. You'll learn how each team works, where it’s strong and where the gaps are. You'll shape the brief and the bar with the hiring manager, pushing back where you have to. You'll run our hardest searches yourself, from mapping the market to closing the offer and helping people relocate. Most of those hires will be people you found rather than people who applied. With the team, you'll work out why a strong scientist or engineer should join eleQtron, and you'll make sure the people we want to hire hear it, through universities, conferences and research networks as well as the usual (and unusual) channels. You'll build the way we hire: structured interviews, scorecards and debriefs that every technical team uses, with the data to show whether they work. You'll coach our hiring managers and interviewers to that standard. You'll have the freedom  to be creative in how you source, and to use AI for the research and admin, so your time goes on judgement and on conversations with people. This is for you if You've outgrown your current role and want to build something. You start things without waiting to be asked, and you finish them. You move with urgency when the picture is still unclear. You'd rather shape an employer brand than inherit one. Hard technical searches interest you more than easy ones. You don't need to have built a recruiting function before. If you have, that helps, but what matters more is your appetite to continually improve and push us forward. If you haven't, we care more that take initiative without being asked and you to and seen it through, taking the time to learn what worked, or not. What’s worth knowing Our People team has a lot to deliver. You'll build while you hire, and the hiring won't wait for the building to finish. Some searches will take months, and the people you talk to will be comparing us with big tech and research labs. You'll also spend regular time at both our Hamburg and Siegen sites. So this probably isn't for you if: You want a settled process to run. You're happy with the way things are and want to keep them that way. You'd rather someone else decided how hiring should work. You need a clear path with little ambiguity. What you'll bring You've recruited scarce technical specialists from start to finish: finding people who weren't looking, persuading them, and closing them through offer and relocation. You’re used to be rejected or ghosted. You've worked closely with technical leaders and shaped what they hire for, with evidence to back your view. You can show us something you initiated that had a meaningful impact without waiting to be asked to do it. You're fluent in English. German is a plus. It helps if you've also built a hiring process, worked on an employer brand or coached other people to a standard. If you haven't, curiosity, a growth mindset and pace go a long way. How we hire A 40-minute call with our Head of People & Culture to find out more about you, your background and experiences, and how this could fit into the role at eleQtron. A 45-60 min light hands-on case study with a short fictional brief that you’ll work through with the hiring manager. Please note, that this job will remain online until the 19th of December for new applications at which point it will be closed. raw.description:
Product Owner Softwareentwicklung (m/w/d)

Bei unserem namhaften Kunden im Raum Aalen - einem führenden Unternehmen der Hightechindustrie - bietet sich diese einmalige Perspektive im Rahmen der Arbeitnehmerüberlassung mit der Option auf Übernahme.

Dein zukünftiger Tätigkeitsbereich

  • Weiterentwicklung der Product Vision einer anspruchsvollen Softwarelösung für die Produktion optischer Hightech-Systeme in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Scrum-Team

  • Übernahme der Produktverantwortung für ein oder mehrere Softwareprodukte im Kontext komplexer Produktionsprozesse

  • Leitung der Anforderungsaufnahme und -analyse in den Produktions- und Entwicklungsbereichen sowie Überführung der Anforderungen in konkrete Entwicklungsaufgaben im Product Backlog einschließlich deren Dokumentation und Priorisierung

  • Fachliche Ansprechperson für die Klärung von Anforderungen und die Beantwortung fachlicher Fragestellungen

  • Abstimmung und Bewertung von Entwicklungsaufwänden gemeinsam mit dem Scrum-Team sowie Mitwirkung an der Sprintplanung

  • Koordination der Schnittstelle zwischen agiler Softwareentwicklung und klassischem Projektmanagement zur Sicherstellung einer abgestimmten kurz- und langfristigen Planung auf Sprint- und Meilensteinebene

  • Verantwortung für die Einführung neuer und weiterentwickelter Softwareprodukte in den Produktionsbereichen sowie Unterstützung der Anwenderinnen und Anwender bei auftretenden Fragestellungen und Problemen

  • Abstimmung mit weiteren Scrum-Teams zur Förderung der teamübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit und zur Standardisierung von Softwarearchitekturen

  • Unterstützung und Förderung der Selbstorganisation und Eigenverantwortung des Scrum-Teams in der Rolle des Servant Leaders

Das zeichnet Dich aus 

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium Informatik (m/w/d), alternativ ein naturwissenschaftliches oder ingenieurwissenschaftliches Studium oder vergleichbar

  • Erfahrung in der Leitung von Softwareprojekten, der Analyse von Anforderungen und fundierte Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung

  • Erfahrung in der Mitarbeit in agilen Teams sowie Erfahrung in der Rolle als Product Owner

  • Ein hohes Prozessverständnis und die Fähigkeit komplexe Probleme einfach zu abstrahieren (z.B. mittels Diagramme)

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (B2)

  • For international applicants: Please note that the business language is German. B2 level is mandatory and must have for this position

Deine berufliche Zukunft

  • Vergütung: Übertarifliche Bezahlung zuzüglich Branchenzuschläge

  • Work-Life-Balance: Uns ist die Vereinbarkeit von Job und Familie sehr wichtig, daher sind 30 Tage Urlaub und ein Gleitzeitkonto selbstverständlich

  • Karriere bei Top Unternehmen: Freue dich auf langfristige Einsätze bei renommierten Unternehmen der Region mit echter Übernahmeoption!

  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: Profitiere von betrieblichen Zusatzleistungen wie Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld, bezuschusste betriebliche Altersvorsorge und VWL

  • Wachsendes Unternehmen: Mit starkem Auftragseingang und Dynamik

  • Firmenveranstaltungen: Freu Dich auf das traditionelle jährliche encontec-Standortfest

  • Persönliche Betreuung: Dein persönlicher Ansprechpartner steht Dir jederzeit zur Seite und kümmert sich um all Deine Anliegen

Stellendetails

Arbeitsort: Oberkochen  
Arbeitszeit: 40-Stunden-Woche

Dauer: 24 Monate

Startdatum: sofort oder nach Absprache
