title: Senior Business Security Consultant
description: About Northwave Defending the digital frontier is our mission. At Northwave, 275 cybersecurity specialists transform how organisations approach digital safety. From our HQ in Utrecht, our DACH HQ in Leipzig and offices in Austria, Sweden, and Belgium. Northwave combines ethical hacking expertise with behavioral psychology insights and cutting-edge security management at the highest level. We respond to threats and anticipate them, providing 24/7 managed security services and tailored solutions for each client's journey. By joining Northwave, you’ll become part of an organisation where innovation drives results, whether your talents lie in technical penetration testing or strategic client partnerships. Here, your expertise will grow and help shape the future of digital security across industries, leaving a lasting impact. Your Mission As a Senior Business Security Consultant , you act as a strategic advisor and trusted partner for our clients. You help organizations navigate their digital transformation in a secure, resilient, and sustainable way. By connecting business objectives with cybersecurity challenges, you translate regulatory requirements and evolving threat landscapes into practical strategies that create measurable business value. Drawing on your experience, you quickly understand complex organizational structures, identify both risks and opportunities, and engage with senior decision-makers as a trusted sparring partner. You take ownership of challenging client engagements, lead projects independently from initial concept through successful delivery, and ensure that recommendations are not only designed but also effectively embedded within the organization. Your projects cover a broad range of topics, including security strategy, risk management, compliance frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001, as well as Northwave's comprehensive Managed Security Services. In this role, you work with mid-sized and large organizations across the DACH region, supporting them in their cybersecurity and business transformation initiatives. As a Senior Consultant, you bring together Northwave's various areas of expertise. You coordinate collaboration between technical, behavioral, and incident response teams, provide functional leadership within multidisciplinary project teams, and ensure that individual measures are integrated into coherent and effective security programs. In addition, you actively contribute to the growth and development of our consulting business. You identify emerging client needs, participate in sales and business development activities, and leverage your expertise to expand our service portfolio. At the same time, you mentor and support colleagues, foster knowledge sharing, and help strengthen the capabilities of the consulting team as a whole. What You Enjoy Analyzing complex business models, industry-specific requirements, and organizational challenges, and translating these insights into tailored security strategies. Leading and successfully delivering large-scale, complex consulting and transformation projects with a high degree of ownership and accountability. Translating evolving threat landscapes and regulatory frameworks such as NIS2, DORA, and ISO 27001 into practical and actionable strategic roadmaps. Advising and challenging executive leadership teams, board members, and other senior stakeholders on cybersecurity-related decisions. Providing guidance, coaching, and functional leadership to colleagues within project teams while actively promoting knowledge sharing across the organization. Facilitating workshops, executive presentations, and strategic decision-making processes at management and board level. Identifying business opportunities and actively contributing to sales, proposal development, and business development activities. Collaborating with interdisciplinary experts to design innovative and effective security solutions for our clients. Continuously expanding your cybersecurity expertise and contributing to the strategic direction and development of our consulting practice. What you can expect from us First things first: You will get 30 days' holiday per year and we contribute a minimum of 20% to your company pension plan (bAV). You can organise your own working hours in consultation with your colleagues and customers. A mobility budget , also for private use, makes trips to your customers easier. Of course, we also pay travelling allowances. What do you want to achieve and what support do you need? You will receive regular training and support in achieving your professional goals. You can also develop further within Northwave. It is important to us to respect and value each other - as professionals and as people. The best way to get to know your 275+ colleagues from the Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Belgium and Sweden is to take part in one of our many activities , such as a trip to the theme park. You will be equipped with a modern MacBook and iPhone . We have height-adjustable desks in our offices and our CEO loves to kit us out with merchandise ;-) what else... No, the fruit basket in the office is not a benefit for us, but a matter of course - just like coffee, tea and lemonade. Have you ever tried Dutch caramel waffles? Consulting Expertise: You bring extensive experience in cybersecurity and/or management consulting and have successfully managed complex transformation and advisory projects in client-facing environments. Trusted Advisor Mindset: You are comfortable challenging and advising executive stakeholders, earning credibility quickly and acting as a trusted advisor throughout strategic decision-making processes. Commercial Awareness: You combine a strong consulting mindset with commercial acumen, helping to identify opportunities, shape client engagements, and support business growth initiatives. Leadership & Mentoring: You enjoy sharing knowledge, coaching colleagues, and contributing to the development of high-performing consulting teams. Languages: Full professional proficiency in German and English is required. Interested? If you are still not sure, see what Working at Northwave looks like. And when you are ready to come on board, we are looking forward to your application. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: (Senior) Business Performance Analyst (all genders)
description: Foodji macht frisches, gutes Essen im Büro jederzeit verfügbar. Unsere autonomen Foodjis stehen in bald tausend Unternehmen in Deutschland, jede Transaktion, jede Lieferung und jedes Gericht erzeugt Daten. Diesen Datenschatz wollen wir noch konsequenter nutzen und die ganze Organisation befähigen, mit starkem AI-Enablement selbst mit Daten zu arbeiten. Dafür suchen wir dich.   Du wirst Teil unseres Finance & BI Teams und arbeitest eng mit Controlling und BI. Wir bauen zusammen die Zahlenbasis, auf der Foodji gesteuert wird und gehen Fragen aus dem Business gemeinsam an: schnell, präzise und mit dem Anspruch, jede Frage bis zur Entscheidung durchzudenken. Deine Mission bei Foodji Ist-Zahlen & Treiber: Du analysierst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling die operativen Treiber hinter den Ist-Zahlen und leitest konkrete Maßnahmen ab für alle Teams. Planung: Du baust treiberbasierte Modelle für Budget und rollierenden Forecast, inklusive Szenarien und Annahmen aus den Fachbereichen. Reporting: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Controlling das Management-, Board- und Investorenreporting weiter, mit Fokus auf Treiber und Ausblick. Business Cases & Unit Economics: Du bewertest neue Standorte, Kundensegmente, Pricing und Initiativen und findest die Hebel für Marge und Wachstum. Metriken: Gemeinsam mit dem BI-Team definierst du Metriken und Business-Logik im Semantic Layer, damit alle mit denselben Zahlen arbeiten. Business Partnering: Du bist Sparringspartner:in für Geschäftsführung, Sales, Account Management, Operations, Culinary und Marketing und begleitest die Umsetzung deiner Empfehlungen. AI-native arbeiten AI ist bei uns das Werkzeug, mit dem wir Analytics bauen. Wir arbeiten täglich mit AI-Tools wie Claude und Claude Code, direkt auf unserem Snowflake Data Warehouse. Du nutzt AI, um Daten zu explorieren und zu analysieren sowie für die Automatisierung von wiederkehrenden Tasks. Du prüfst Ergebnisse kritisch, auch die zugrunde liegenden Abfragen, bevor sie in eine Entscheidung gehen, und befähigst andere Teams, selbst mit Daten und AI zu arbeiten. Das bringst du mit 2 bis 5 Jahre Erfahrung in FP&A, Controlling, Corporate Finance, Beratung oder Investment Banking, idealerweise in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen. Ein sehr gutes Studium in Wirtschaft, Finance, Wirtschaftsinformatik, Mathematik, Informatik oder einem verwandten Fach. Sehr gute Modellierungsskills in Excel und Erfahrung mit BI-Tools wie Tableau. Nachweisbare Praxis mit AI-Tools für Analytics, z.B. Claude Code, Claude oder vergleichbaren Tools. Zeig uns, was du damit gebaut hast. Tempo und Ownership: Du wartest nicht auf Aufträge, siehst die nächste Frage, bevor sie gestellt wird, und bringst Dinge zu Ende. Ein gutes Verständnis dafür, wie Zahlen, Operations und Go-to-Market zusammenhängen. Du übersetzt komplexe Analysen in eine klare Botschaft, für das Management genauso wie für Kolleg:innen ohne Finance-Hintergrund und sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch. Du kennst das Need-to-know-Prinzip und die Trennung unvereinbarer Funktionen aus der Praxis und kannst diese Anforderungen in Berechtigungskonzepten abbilden. Du hast mit Active Directory oder Microsoft Entra ID gearbeitet. Du kannst Berechtigungen systematisch prüfen, Abweichungen erkennen und ihre Klärung mit den Verantwortlichen vorantreiben. Du arbeitest sorgfältig, dokumentierst vollständig und kannst deine Vorgehensweise auch gegenüber Prüfern verständlich erläutern. Du erklärst Fachbereichen nachvollziehbar, welche Zugriffe für eine Aufgabe erforderlich sind und wo Grenzen bestehen. Du koordinierst die Umsetzung mit technischen Ansprechpartnern und Dienstleistern und hältst offene Maßnahmen und vereinbarte Termine nach. Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und strukturiert und behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Anfragen den Überblick. Ein Plus, aber kein Muss Erfahrung mit IAM- oder PAM-Werkzeugen und Mehr-Faktor-Authentifizierung. Kenntnisse der Anforderungen an Berechtigungen aus DORA und MaRisk. Erfahrung mit Berechtigungen in Bankanwendungen eines zentralen Rechenzentrums. Erfahrung mit Gast- und Partnerzugängen in Microsoft 365. description: <h2><strong>The Role</strong></h2> <p>This is an excellent opportunity to join Teneo’s well established Financial Advisory team in Cardiff. You will work alongside experienced practitioners advising the management teams, lenders and shareholders of businesses that are underperforming and/or facing any financial challenges.</p> <p>The Cardiff team delivers complex, high-profile advisory and formal insolvency appointments, both locally and nationally and across a range of sectors. As a Senior Consultant, you will be exposed to a variety of projects in areas such as debt advisory, accelerated M&amp;A, insolvency, performance improvement and financial forecasting.</p> <p>As a Senior Consultant, you will contribute to a range of projects including restructuring, insolvency, financial forecasting and transaction support. You will take responsibility for delivering key pieces of analysis, while continuing to develop your technical and client-facing skills.</p> <p>The position encourages growth and career development, with a clear path of progression. You will develop a broad skill set across financial modelling, report writing, and stakeholder management, as well as being involved with business development activities that will build your network.</p> <p>You will primarily be based in our Cardiff office, with opportunities to work at client sites and collaborate with colleagues across other locations.</p> <h2><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h2> <p><strong><em>Client Service</em></strong></p> <p>On a day-to-day basis, you will be a key team member working on financial restructuring and insolvency engagements. With guidance, your role will include:</p> <ul> <li>Lead discrete workstreams on restructuring and insolvency assignments</li> <li>Produce clear, high-quality client deliverables that inform key decisions</li> <li>Analyse financial performance and support the development of forecasts</li> <li>Assisting the production of high-quality reports and information memorandums to support restructuring and refinance transactions.</li> <li>Work directly with management teams and stakeholders to gather and challenge information</li> <li>Support delivery of formal insolvency processes where required</li> <li>Undertaking ad hoc assignments on insolvency appointments such as realising assets, managing suppliers, and instructing other professionals/agents.</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Knowledge Acquisition</em></strong></p> <p>With support, you will be expected to develop a broad range of skills, including:</p> <ul> <li>Building client relationship skills, sector knowledge and leadership skills to support ongoing career progression</li> <li>Build technical expertise of restructuring, market awareness and Teneo’s Financial Advisory propositions</li> <li>Developing a range of report writing, project management, and advisory skills</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>People and Leadership</em></strong></p> <p>You will continue to build on your client relationship, business advisory and people management skills and, as your career progresses, you will have an increasing opportunity to lead junior colleagues. Core elements of your role from day one will include:</p> <ul> <li>Support leadership in creating an inclusive environment and proactively support the development of junior colleagues through coaching and feedback</li> <li>Contribute to a collaborative and inclusive team culture</li> <li>Share knowledge and help improve ways of working</li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Business Development</em></strong></p> <p>Business development is a critical aspect of the team’s day-to-day activities and you will be expected to pro-actively contribute in this area by:</p> <ul> <li>Contribute to proposals, pitches and market research</li> <li>Help identify opportunities to support existing and new clients</li> <li>Build your professional network within the restructuring market</li> <li>Supporting colleagues to run a key account team, including participating in, and organising, client events.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Key Skills &amp; Experience</strong></h2> <p>In addition to your ambition to learn, develop and progress, we require an individual with the following core skills:</p> <ul> <li>ACA/ACCA/ICAS or equivalent qualification or experience (fully qualified)</li> <li>Experience in an advisory or auditing environment</li> <li>Client first outlook, with the ability to work quickly and establish effective working relationships with clients and colleagues</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and confidence working with financial data</li> <li>Clear written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Ability to take ownership of work and deliver to deadlines</li> <li>Be a self-starter demonstrating initiative, with a strong track record of achievement</li> <li>Experience of writing internal and/or client deliverables.</li> <li>Experience of using standard IT packages such as Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Preferred qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in restructuring, insolvency or transaction-related work</li> <li>Financial modelling or forecasting experience</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What can we offer you?</strong></h2> <p>New joiners are supported by an induction programme.&nbsp; As well as this we offer a whole host of benefits and reward including;</p> <ul> <li>Market-leading Salary</li> <li>28 days holiday</li> <li>Cash benefits allowance</li> <li>Discretionary Bonus Scheme</li> <li>Company pension scheme</li> <li>Extensive investment in personal development &amp; learning</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity leave (depending on length of service) and shared parental leave</li> <li>Life assurance</li> <li>Cycle to work schemes</li> <li>Regular social, cultural and charitable activities</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About Teneo</strong></h2> <p>Teneo is the global CEO advisory firm. We partner with our clients globally to do great things for a better future.</p> <p>Drawing upon our global team and expansive network of senior advisors, we provide advisory services across our five business segments on a stand-alone or fully integrated basis to help our clients solve complex business challenges. Our clients include a significant number of the Fortune 100 and FTSE 100, as well as other corporations, financial institutions, and organizations.</p> <p>Our full range of advisory services includes strategic communications, investor relations, financial transactions and restructuring, management consulting, physical and cyber risk, organizational design, board and executive search, geopolitics and government affairs, corporate governance, ESG and DE&amp;I.</p> <p>The firm has more than 1,600 employees located in 45+ offices around the world.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Techary redefines the way customers procure, implement, and support their organisations' technology, providing an innovative alternative to the traditional Managed Service Provider (MSP) / Value-Added Reseller (VAR) approach.&nbsp;</p> <p>Our concept, “Technology, done differently”, embodies our belief that the way our customers&nbsp;consume and utilize technology&nbsp;should innovate at the same pace as the technology itself.</p> <p>Our customers range from small start-ups to global enterprises. You will be the first voice candidates hear from us, running screening calls, keeping Greenhouse in shape and sourcing for our harder-to-fill roles. You will also support people operations with administration tasks and learn our HR processes as you go.</p> <p>Success in this role comes from a full diary of calls every week, a high share of your shortlists reaching second interview, and close collaboration with hiring managers.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(71, 215, 172);">Key Responsibilities:</span></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h4>Talent acquisition</h4> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Run first-round screening calls by phone and video, for inbound applicants and candidates you have sourced</li> <li>Put forward candidates hiring managers want to meet, with a high share of shortlists reaching second interview</li> <li>Own the ATS for your roles, keeping Greenhouse accurate, candidates in the right stages and nobody left waiting</li> <li>Source candidates for harder-to-fill roles through LinkedIn Recruiter and other channels</li> <li>Work closely with hiring managers to book interviews and gather feedback quickly</li> <li>Keep candidates warm and informed at every stage of the process</li> </ul> <h2>&nbsp;</h2> <h4>People ops</h4> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Administration tasks, and the chance to learn our HR processes.</p> <ul> <li>Coordinate background checks and right-to-work verification</li> <li>Support onboarding and the employee lifecycle, including starters, leavers and internal changes</li> <li>Maintain employee records and HR documentation</li> <li>Prepare starter paperwork, including contracts and onboarding packs</li> <li>Support the HR team with day-to-day queries and general administration</li> <li>Help with wider people initiatives</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><span style="color: #47d7ac;">Essential Skills:</span></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>1–3 years’ recruitment experience, in-house or agency, ideally as a resourcer, sourcer or junior recruiter</li> <li>Confident screening candidates by phone and video, with the ability to build rapport and ask the right questions</li> <li>Experience using LinkedIn Recruiter to source and approach candidates</li> <li>Proven ability to manage a high volume of roles and candidates at once</li> <li>Organised and persistent, keeping candidates and roles moving</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication skills</li> <li>Appetite for fast-paced growth</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: #47d7ac;">Desirable Skills:</span></h3> <ul> <li>Experience with an ATS or HRIS, ideally Greenhouse</li> <li>Experience sourcing for harder-to-fill roles</li> <li>Interest in building people operations experience alongside recruitment</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><span style="color: #47d7ac;">Why Techary</span></h3> <ul> <li><em>Growth that is real. </em>Revenue grew 84.7% in 2025, entirely organically, with no outside investors, and we remain profitable. We have been in The Sunday Times 100 two years running, climbing from 75th to 59th.</li> <li><em>A team that is scaling fast. </em>We have grown from 65 people in January 2024 to 150 today, and AI-powered tools are in use across every team.</li> <li><em>A great place to work. </em>Our engagement score is 8.2 out of 10 against a 6.9 national average, and 8.8 out of 10 would recommend us.</li> <li><em>Room to grow. </em>Monthly 1-2-1s with your manager, paid training and courses, and promotion from within whenever we can. If you are proactive, you will be given real ownership.</li> <li><em>Open and flat. </em>Monthly company-wide meetings, and you can speak openly with anyone in the business, including senior leadership and the CEO.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(71, 215, 172);"><strong>Benefits</strong></span></h3> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Techary, we embrace a family culture and believe in working as a team to overcome any challenge we face.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>Employee benefits include:</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Birthday as a free day holiday.</li> <li>Social events run throughout the year.</li> <li>Free breakfast, snacks and drinks.</li> <li>Lunch provided Friday.</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <p>Job Type: Permanent</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h4>Equal Opportunities &amp; Diversity Policy</h4> <p>Techary is committed to promoting equality of opportunity for all staff and job applicants. description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. ISO 27001 Lead Auditor

About Calibre

Calibre is building an AI-native certification body. Our platform helps auditors review evidence, document findings and prepare reports, giving them more time to test whether controls work in practice. Auditors retain responsibility for every finding.


The role

We’re hiring a Lead Auditor to deliver independent ISO/IEC 27001 certification audits, witness new auditors and help shape the tools our audit team uses. You’ll work with colleagues in certification, product and engineering to make the audit process clearer and easier to use.


What you’ll do

  • Lead Stage 1 and Stage 2 certification audits, as well as surveillance and recertification audits.

  • Plan audit activities, select defensible samples and test whether information security controls operate in practice.

  • Experience leading third-party ISO 27001 certification audits in a certification-body setting.

  • Enough hands-on understanding of cloud and security infrastructure to assess evidence such as IAM policies, infrastructure configuration and audit logs.

  • Clear writing and sound audit judgement. You can explain your conclusions to a client’s technical team and defend them in a review.

  • Interest in using AI-assisted tools in audit work and the judgement to verify their output against the underlying evidence.

Create your Auditor Passport and upload your CV. If you have your Lead Auditor certificate and audit log to hand, please include those too.

About Motorway

Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the team

Hi, I'm Mariot, I lead Engineering here at Motorway. We're around 70 engineers across product teams, building the marketplace and all services around that handles hundreds of vehicle transactions every day. We care about delivering value to the business, getting the architecture engineering sound, keeping the production bar high, and being early and deliberate about the technology we adopt.

We have been early adopters of GenAI for software engineering, we've built a reputation for that, and we'd like to keep earning it. AI is enabling us to deliver faster at a much higher quality software while easing the maintenance of our existing services.

About the role

We're looking for a Principal Engineer to set technical direction and evolve engineering practices across Motorway, reporting to the Director of Engineering. This is a broad role: your remit spans multiple product areas and every engineering specialties, and your decisions will shape what we build, what we buy, and what we retire.

You'll work with engineering leadership, product, and other functions stakeholders to continuously evolve our overall architecture and practices, and with our senior and staff engineers to turn that direction into working software.

You will own our relationships with AWS on the engineering side, our main cloud provider. It's the foundation of our platform and one of our most important partnerships. In practice, we expect you to lead the following activities:

  • Frequently meet AWS representatives getting access to latest services and features, share feedback on our usage and needs, and be an early tester and adopter of new services/

  • Identify new services we could adopt to continuously improve our reliability and ability to build new services and features at pace for the business.

  • Share internally good practices on software engineering at the edge and usage of AWS services, including continuously updating technical recommendations for humans and agents.

You'll represent Motorway on stage at external events and in the wider engineering community, and you'll set the standard for how engineers here present their work internally.

You'll also lead on our adoption of AI for software engineering. We give engineers access to the latest models through Kiro, and we want someone who can define what good looks like when domain depth, AI-enabled breadth, and rigorous evaluation all have to work together.

In this role, you will:

  • Set technical strategy across multiple product areas, and make the commercial case for it to leadership with data rather than assertion

  • Identify cross-cutting architectural risks and resolve them before they block us at scale

  • Set engineering standards, architectural patterns, and documentation norms, including the writing precision that makes specs reliable inputs for both engineers and agent systems

  • Raise the reliability, observability, and security bar across engineering: SLO philosophy, incident management standards, production readiness, and threat models that hold up in the AI era

  • Be a force of innovation on AI for Software Engineering.: Monitor our LLM usage, latest models trial and evaluation, technical debt modernisation through AI agents.

  • Develop staff engineers and technical leads, multiplying leadership capacity across the organisation

  • Own the AWS relationship on the engineering side: architecture reviews with their solution architects, early access programmes, and the calls on which services we adopt, when, and at what cost

  • Speak for Motorway in public, at AWS summits, conferences and meetups, and raise the bar internally for how engineers present their work to each other and to the business

About you

  • Ten years or more in software engineering, with several of those spent operating at Staff or Principal level

  • A track record of setting technical direction across several teams or product areas, where your decisions changed company outcomes

  • Exceptional AWS expertise, both wide and deep. You've designed, operated and paid the bill for serverless, containers, networking, identity and data services at production scale, and you can hold your own in a room of AWS solution architects

  • The judgement to evaluate new platforms and services against structured technical and commercial criteria, and to say no to the ones that don't earn their place

  • Strong grounding in API and identity architecture: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, PKCE, JWT, and IAM patterns across multiple accounts

  • Experience setting observability and reliability standards, and running incident practice that teams take seriously

  • Comfort across the stack: you can read or write code in most languages, and follow a request from the browser through to the data layer

  • A record of developing senior engineers into technical leaders, and of raising the hiring bar in your discipline

  • Practical experience building with LLMs and agents in production, including how you evaluate them and keep their output trustworthy

  • A strong public speaker with a track record to show us. You've presented at conferences, summits or large internal forums, and you can make a technical argument land with a room of engineers or a room of executives

  • Writing that holds up under scrutiny: specs, architecture decision records, and strategy documents that others can act on without a meeting

You could be a great fit if

  • You create clarity in situations where no obvious technical path exists

  • You challenge the status quo with evidence and worked alternatives, and you have the patience to bring people with you

  • You argue for the simplest architecture that meets the requirement, because you've lived with the long-term cost of the alternative

  • You carry a pattern library of production failures and over-engineered systems, and you use it to stop others repeating expensive mistakes

  • You want the stage rather than tolerate it, and you're as comfortable in a keynote slot as you are in a Monday morning team demo

  • You enjoy making the engineers around you better, whether that's mentoring, review, or helping someone prepare their first public talk

  • You stay curious about new tools and honest about which ones are worth adopting

We offer a fantastic range of benefits to help you thrive:

  • Great work-life balance

  • London office location with regular social events, office drinks and free snacks to keep you going

  • Hybrid work schedule with 2 days per week in our Central London office

  • Stock options so you can share in Motorway's growth and future success

  • Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

  • Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc

  • Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including dental care and fitness discounts

  • Cycle to work scheme, save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

The Opportunity

9fin’s Engineering org has grown rapidly to more than 150 engineers across multiple tribes, and we are continuing to expand.

AI sits at the centre of what we ship to customers and of how our teams design, build and release software. We are seeking a Director of Engineering to set the technical vision and lead multiple high-impact teams responsible for our Product Foundations area, the foundations (web and other distribution channels) that delivers 9fin to our customers.

This role requires a deeply technical, AI-first leader who owns delivery end to end and understands how engineering drives the commercial success of the business. You will lead by example, establishing a culture of engineering excellence where teams tackle complex challenges, innovate boldly, and grow their skills.

We are looking for an experienced leader with a proven track record of scaling both systems and teams. You will define architecture, drive strategy across the group, and empower leaders and ICs to deliver at scale while staying close enough to the details to mentor and inspire your teams.

As Director for Product Foundations, your role is to amplify the impact of your teams, making strategic decisions that shape the long-term direction of the area. You will ensure reliability, enable rapid innovation, and create the conditions for lasting technical and cultural impact. You'll help shape how a 150+ person engineering org works in an AI-native way, and you'll be measured on what reaches customers and what it does for the business.

Product Foundations: Every 9fin product runs on the same core capabilities: authentication, entitlements, notifications and the other shared services that every customer touches and every product team relies on. Your customers are 9fin’s product engineering teams, and you’ll lead with a platform-as-a-product mindset: treat shared capabilities as products, with clear roadmaps, well-designed APIs and documentation, self-serve onboarding and defined SLOs, measuring success through adoption, reliability and developer satisfaction. Get this right and every squad ships faster and focuses on its own customers, every customer gets a seamless and secure experience, and 9fin can launch new products on foundations built to scale.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s a dose of the kind of things you’ll be doing:

  • Provide strategic & technical leadership over multiple teams in the Product Foundations area, ensuring alignment with company objectives and technical direction.

  • Build and scale high-performing, cross-functional teams, and grow your Engineering Leads and ICs into stronger leaders with wider technical reach.

  • Set the long-term technical vision, driving architectural decisions that enable future growth and system evolution.

  • Partner with Product, Design, Commercial and Customer teams to understand how your area drives revenue and retention, and prioritise the work that moves the business.

  • Work closely with fellow Engineering leaders and leaders to align roadmaps, resolve cross-team dependencies and make shared decisions, succeeding together as one 9fin engineering team.

  • Foster a culture of engineering excellence through mentorship, standard-setting, and championing robust engineering practices across teams.

  • Own hiring for your area, partnering with the VP Engineering and our People and Talent teams to build strong, AI-fluent teams.

  • Own delivery for the area end to end: set commitments with Product, track them, and be accountable for outcomes across large cross-team programmes.

  • Oversee technical operations and incident response practices across teams, ensuring high system reliability and actionable learning from incidents.

  • Identify and drive systemic improvements to engineering velocity, platform reliability and security, building security in from the start and adopting tooling, including AI, where it measurably helps teams ship faster and safer.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Are a deeply technical engineering leader with a software development background and a track record of leading multiple teams and managers in complex, high-growth environments.

  • Technical in practice: Earn technical credibility with senior engineers: you review designs in depth, challenge architecture constructively, and can still get hands-on when needed.

  • Have defined, owned and executed technical strategy, scaled systems, and tied engineering investment to business outcomes.

  • Have designed and evolved cross-functional engineering orgs as they scale.

  • Have built or led internal platforms run as products: you engage your internal customers, prioritise based on their needs, and measure success through adoption, reliability and developer experience.

  • Think commercially: you understand how your work drives revenue and retention, and you balance customer experience, architecture and resilience accordingly.

  • Communicate clearly and influence across engineering, product, design, commercial and executive leadership.

  • Are a collaborative peer who builds strong partnerships with other engineering leaders and puts 9fin’s success ahead of team boundaries.

  • Develop senior engineering talent, build succession plans, and create an inclusive environment where leaders grow their impact.

  • Deliver on commitments while raising operational maturity and reliability across a growing organisation.

We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

Training & Culture

  • Professional learning and development budget

This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage our agency and partner ecosystem, partner with the effectiveness team on measurement standards that prove what's working, and build in-house media capability. You'll set direction and raise the bar across the team, while staying close enough to the detail to step in when it matters.

In this role as the Head of Media, you will...🚄

Media strategy and planning

  • Own the global media strategy and the quarterly planning cycle across all markets, balancing brand awareness and performance outcomes

  • Bring structure and consistency to planning processes so markets plan to a common standard while keeping room for local nuance

  • Manage budget allocation, reforecasting and in-flight optimisation as priorities and budgets shift

  • Align closely with Brand, Growth, GTM, Creative and Country Managers so media plans reflect business priorities

Sponsorship, partnerships and retail media

  • Line-manage the Sponsorship Lead and Sponsorship Executive, owning sponsorship strategy, portfolio and budget, and explore partnership and retail media opportunities with travel, hospitality, events and lifestyle brands

In-house capability

  • Lead the evolution of in-house media buying, defining what we do ourselves versus through agencies, and scaling the model across markets

  • Champion AI and automation in media planning, reporting and operations, and encourage the team to experiment

Measurement and learning, compliance and brand safety

  • Shape a measurement and learning framework with the effectiveness team and Data Science, and make sure media activity meets privacy, consent and brand safety standards across every market

  • Make sure media activity meets privacy and consent requirements (including GDPR, ePrivacy and cookie consent) in every market, working with Legal, Privacy and Data teams

Leadership and culture

  • Lead, coach and develop a team of specialists, closing priority capability gaps, building individual development plans, and creating a collaborative, high-trust culture across media, studio, Marketing and Data Science

We'd love to hear from you if you have...🔍

  • A strong background in media, ideally spanning both agency and client side, with meaningful experience leading teams

  • Experience planning and managing multi-market, multi-channel media, including TV, OOH, video, social, audio and digital

  • Fluency in a second European language, such as French, Italian or Spanish, is helpful but not essential

  • A track record of managing media agency relationships and direct partnerships with major platforms and media owners

  • Experience managing large, multi-market media budgets, including forecasting and sign-off with Finance and Procurement

  • A solid grounding in measurement and effectiveness, such as MMM, incrementality or brand lift experimentation, ideally gained alongside analytics or effectiveness teams

  • Experience working closely with brand and creative teams to shape media-led creative ideas

  • A commercially minded approach to negotiation, along with the confidence to build trust and drive outcomes with senior stakeholders

title: Satellite Mechanical Design Engineer
description: Company NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there. Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris. Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators. Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it. Role Overview You will design satellite structure and hardware, and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised and under control as the design matures. Working within a small, multidisciplinary team, you will translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing. Key Responsibilities Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, including secondary structures (panels, brackets and component mounts), thermal-control hardware, cable and harness routing, and mechanisms. Primary structure experience is welcome. Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, using top-down design and skeleton models to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model. Manage assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released. Required Skills & Experience Bachelor's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline. 3+ years' experience in mechanical design of aerospace, space or other high-reliability hardware, with strong 3D CAD skills (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered). Practical application of GD&T and experience producing manufacturing-ready drawings. Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics. Demonstrated ability to design, build and test hardware, including troubleshooting and iteration. Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team. Preferred Experience Satellite or spacecraft design, ideally detailed design of secondary structures (panel and component mounting, thermal hardware, cable and harness routing). Experience with PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM), configuration management, revision control and formal change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN). Experience working within formal engineering processes, such as design reviews, documented requirements and standards. Hardware that has launched. Basic FEA familiarity, MGSE or ground-support equipment design, and electromechanical packaging. Why NewOrbit Space? Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success. raw.description:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role: Senior Content & Search Activation Lead (6 Month-FTC)

Location: London, or Northampton, England (3 days a week on-site from our Client's offices)

THE OPPORTUNITY

This is a six-month contract opportunity to join OLIVER'S managed services team, embedded within our client, a leading & Global Banking Institution.  Sitting within their Marketing Centre of Excellence as a Senior Content & AI Search Specialist, you'll be responsible for turning search, GEO and audience insight into live content and customer experiences across priority journeys.

Based in London or Northampton, with a hybrid working pattern (three days a week on-site), you'll take insight from specialist agency partners and turn it into approved, delivery-ready content and digital briefs, working with delivery teams to get activity live. Your judgement and writing will help the Unified Search programme improve how customers find and use our client's content.

About the role: 

This is a hybrid activation role that combines content strategy, SEO, copywriting, campaign management and stakeholder management. Rather than being the primary source of search insight, you'll add value by translating specialist recommendations into clear, prioritised and deliverable activity. Your value is in taking recommendations from partners such as OMD and Profound, checking them against the Unified Search strategy, and shaping them into clear, prioritised activity.  

You'll secure the right approvals and work with Delivery Managers and Digital Delivery teams to move work into delivery. You'll use AI-enabled tools and workflows, such as Profound and Pencil Pro, to speed up briefing and content creation, while applying careful human judgement.  

You'll help build confidence in the Supercharge model by keeping recommendations moving from insight to approval, delivery and post-live learning. You'll work across a matrix of Product, Content, Design, Digital Delivery, Legal, Compliance and agency partners, with no direct reports. 

What you will be doing: 

  • Move search, GEO and content recommendations from agency insight or content brief through to deployment-ready activity. 
  • Review recommendations from OMD, Profound and other insight sources, and confirm they fit the Unified Search strategy, customer journey priorities and sprint objectives. 
  • Work with Product stakeholders, including product owners, to secure alignment and sign-off before activity moves into delivery. 
  • Use Profound, Pencil Pro and other AI-enabled workflows to shape content, write briefs, develop copy and optimise pages. 
  • Write, edit and refine copy and messaging where needed, turning recommendations into clear and usable content outputs. 
  • Work with the assigned Delivery Manager to translate recommendations into clear content, optimisation and digital delivery requirements. 
  • Check with Content, Design, Digital Delivery and agency partners that requirements are clear, prioritised and complete before handover. 
  • Prepare opportunities for the relevant sign-off board and coordinate stakeholder input where approval is needed. 
  • Maintain a visible backlog for your area or sprint wave, so recommendations are prioritised, progressed and tracked. 
  • Decide whether to progress, pause, re-scope or escalate an opportunity, based on risk, dependency and delivery readiness. 
  • Flag blockers, dependencies and governance issues early, and escalate them clearly through the Supercharge operating model. 
  • Make sure all content aligns with our client's brand, tone of voice, accessibility, legal, compliance and risk requirements. 
  • Feed live performance results and learnings back into future sprint activity. 
  • Risk and Control Objective: Ensure that all activities and duties are carried out in full compliance with regulatory requirements, Enterprise-Wide Risk Management Framework and our clients' internal Policies and Policy Standards. 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Experience across financial services or a heavily regulated industry
  • Experience in content strategy, content design, copywriting or digital content. 
  • A good understanding of SEO principles, including search intent, page structure, metadata, internal linking, content quality and customer journey optimisation. 
  • Understanding of GEO and AI search principles, or a strong appetite and ability to learn quickly. 
  • Experience reviewing, writing or refining digital content, and turning recommendations into actionable briefs. 
  • Skill in using insight, customer need and search data to shape practical content and optimisation activity. 
  • Stakeholder management experience with Product, Content, Design, Digital, Legal, Compliance or agency teams. 
  • Experience taking work through approval, governance or delivery processes in a regulated environment. 
  • Organisational skills, including managing backlogs, priorities and actions, and keeping work moving through ambiguity and competing priorities. 
  • Clear communication, including explaining search and content recommendations to non-specialist stakeholders. 
  • Experience applying sound judgement and working within appropriate risk, legal, compliance and governance controls. 
  • Confidence using Gen AI tools to improve the quality and speed of content, briefing and optimisation activity. 
  • An ability to adopt and help embed repeatable AI-assisted content and briefing workflows. 
  • A systematic approach to breaking down complex, multi-step challenges. 
  • Sound judgement about where AI can add value and where human review, specialist expertise and governance are required.

Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK and the following US states: FL, IL, MA, MD, NY, PA, TX, VA.</em></strong></p> <p><strong><em>Role Summary&nbsp;</em></strong></p> <p>As Director, Editorial, you will provide strategic leadership for all editorial functions, setting editorial policies and ensuring the scientific scope, selection criteria, authorship profile, and integrity standards of our journals in support of PLOS's mission and sustainability. You will be a champion of PLOS’s transformative vision for global, equitable open science while maintaining research integrity standards and contributing sustainably to organizational growth and impact.</p> <p>You will play a key role in advancing our strategy, enabling the conversion of PLOS's business model from APCs to institutional and other new revenue models, and evolving our publishing capabilities while ensuring that PLOS’s editorial quality, content integrity and scientific relevance underpin the value of our portfolio and its financial sustainability. You will evolve editorial methods and criteria to meet the challenges of scale and adapt to a rapidly changing research environment, including a focus on the responsible use of AI in research, scholarly communication and publishing. Gérer les prérequis techniques (Windows Server, réseau, VPN, SFTP, certificats) et résoudre les problèmes d'intégration. 📋 Gérer tes projets de bout en bout Animer les cadrages techniques et identifier les besoins des établissements. Coordonner les équipes IT hospitalières et les interlocuteurs internes. Suivre les déploiements, anticiper les risques et garantir les mises en production. 🔍 Garantir le bon fonctionnement de nos solutions Réaliser les tests techniques et fonctionnels avec les clients. Diagnostiquer les incidents et assurer le support technique de niveau 2. Surveiller les flux et anticiper les dysfonctionnements. 🤝 Être un interlocuteur technique de confiance Accompagner les équipes IT hospitalières dans l'intégration de nos solutions. Vulgariser les sujets techniques et proposer des solutions adaptées aux contraintes terrain. 🚀 Améliorer continuellement nos déploiements Documenter les configurations et les procédures. Identifier des opportunités d'automatisation et de standardisation. Partager les retours terrain avec les équipes Produit et R&D. ⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons Avant tout, un profil technique qui aime piloter des projets, résoudre des problèmes et travailler au contact des clients. 🖥️ De solides bases techniques Expérience en déploiement, intégration ou administration de logiciels. Connaissances en Windows Server, réseaux (TCP/IP, VPN, SFTP), sécurité et intégration applicative. Capacité à analyser des logs et résoudre des incidents techniques. 📋 Une expérience en gestion de projet technique Expérience dans la coordination de déploiements logiciels chez des clients. Capacité à organiser, prioriser et faire avancer plusieurs sujets en parallèle. 🤝 Une vraie aisance relationnelle À l'aise avec des interlocuteurs techniques comme métiers. Capacité à vulgariser, communiquer clairement et instaurer une relation de confiance. 🛠️ Un esprit orienté résolution de problèmes Autonomie, rigueur, proactivité et goût pour l'investigation technique. Envie de mettre les mains dans le cambouis autant que de coordonner les projets. 🏥 Une connaissance du secteur de la santé est un plus Mais ce n'est pas indispensable : si tu disposes d'un solide socle technique et d'une expérience en déploiement logiciel, nous pourrons t'accompagner dans la découverte des spécificités du secteur hospitalier. 👥 Notre process de recrutement Premier échange RH avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager (30 minutes) Entretien manager avec Loïc (45 minutes) Cas pratique technique à préparer chez soi, puis restitution et discussion avec l'équipe dans nos locaux (1 heure) Entretien final avec deux Lifeners d'une autre équipe Soigner mieux en soignant ensemble, c'est aussi agir avec bienveillance. raw.title: Senior Software & Cloud Engineer (H/F)
raw.description:
→ Votre mission

En tant que Senior Software & Cloud Engineer, vous concevez, développez et déployez des solutions logicielles et IA scalables sur des environnements cloud de production. Vous interviendrez à la fois sur :

  • le développement d'applications et d'APIs robustes ;

  • la conception d'architectures cloud-native et le déploiement de solutions sur l'un des principaux hyperscalers (AWS, GCP ou Azure) ;

  • l'automatisation des infrastructures (IaC) et des chaînes de livraison continue (CI/CD) pour industrialiser nos solutions.

→ Vos responsabilités

  • Concevoir et développer des applications et APIs, sécurisées et scalables

  • Architecturer, déployer et maintenir des solutions en production sur AWS, GCP ou Azure

  • Automatiser le provisionnement des infrastructures via des outils d'Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi…)

  • Mettre en place et optimiser les pipelines CI/CD et l'orchestration de conteneurs (Kubernetes, ECS, Cloud Run…)

  • Assurer l'observabilité, la sécurité (IAM, réseau) et l'optimisation des coûts (FinOps) des environnements déployés

  • Participer à l'intégration et à l'industrialisation de solutions IA / GenAI en environnement cloud

  • Participer aux code reviews, challenger les choix d'architecture et partager les bonnes pratiques engineering

  • Encadrer et faire monter en compétences des profils juniors (selon séniorité)

  • Contribuer à la R&D, aux projets internes transverses (sécurité, tooling, formation, innovation) et ponctuellement aux phases d'avant-vente / cadrage technique

Profil recherché

Nous cherchons le match parfait 💓 … mais nous croyons à la richesse des rencontres ! Alors si vous n'êtes pas certain.e de matcher notre recherche, nous vous encourageons à nous contacter quand même ✉️

✅ Must have

  • Expérience significative en déploiement et administration d'applications sur au moins un hyperscaler (AWS, GCP ou Azure)

  • Pratique d'un outil d'Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi…)

  • Maîtrise de Docker et d'au moins un orchestrateur ou service managé de conteneurs (Kubernetes, ECS, GKE, AKS, Cloud Run…)

  • Solide expérience avec Git et la mise en place de pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps…)

  • Bonnes connaissances des fondamentaux réseau, sécurité cloud (gestion des droits IAM, secrets, VPC) et monitoring

  • Culture générale en IA : connaissance de l'état de l'art, des modèles, des pratiques de développement et des architectures agentiques

  • Expérience confirmée avec au moins un langage de programmation (Python, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, Go…)

  • Solide maîtrise du développement logiciel, des architectures web/APIs et des bases de données (SQL / NoSQL)

  • Expérience avec des frameworks backend et/ou frontend (NestJS, FastAPI, Spring, React, Angular…)

🌈 Nice to have

  • Certifications cloud (AWS Solutions Architect / Developer, GCP Cloud Engineer / Architect, Azure Administrator / Developer)

  • Expérience en déploiement d'architectures agentiques

  • Expérience MLOps et déploiement de modèles IA / LLM en production (Vertex AI, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, MLflow, Kubeflow…)

  • Expérience en architectures data et streaming (Kafka, RabbitMQ, Airflow, BigQuery, Redshift…)

  • Pratiques FinOps et optimisation des performances cloud

  • Culture forte des tests automatisés (unitaires, intégration, charge — TDD apprécié)

  • Maîtrise des environnements UNIX & scripting (Bash)

  • Appétence produit, sens du service et aisance dans la relation client

🤩 Les gens disent de vous que…

  • Vous êtes engagé.e et aimez aller au bout des choses

  • Vous êtes curieux.se, autonome et adaptable

  • Vous aimez travailler en équipe et partager vos connaissances

  • Vous êtes à l'aise dans des environnements exigeants et en évolution rapide

  • Vous partagez nos valeurs : confiance, empowerment, excellence, innovation

title: Account Executive, Mid-Market (France)
description: Artificial Intelligence. Actual Impact. At Docebo, we’re using AI to change how people learn at work—and we mean actually change it. We’re an AI-powered learning platform that helps organizations create, deliver, and manage training all in one place. But our real mission goes deeper: we help teams move faster, work smarter, and focus on the work that truly matters. Our platform is built with intelligent, time-saving tools that personalize learning, eliminate busywork, and turn training from a checkbox into a superpower. The result? Better experiences for learners and real results for businesses. We’re shaping the future of learning with a team that isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. If you're excited by the idea of using AI to make work-life better for real people–you’ll feel right at home here. And it’s not just what we build, it’s how we show up. At Docebo, our values aren’t just posters on the wall—they guide how we work every day. We call it the Docebo Heart : trust by default, assume positive intent, and create space for different perspectives to thrive. Want to get a better feel for what it's like to work at Docebo? Check out our Life page on our LinkedIn to get a glimpse into our culture, people, and the experiences that make Docebo a great place to grow your career. So… what are you waiting for? Join 900+ Docebians around the world and help us reinvent the way people learn, because learning never stops. The Adventure Ahead 🚀 Are you ready to spearhead Docebo’s growth across France, Belgium, and Luxembourg (FBL)? As our Account Executive, Mid-Market, you’ll own a high-impact territory, bringing our industry-leading AI learning platform to mid-sized organizations with 1,000 to 5,000 employees. Working alongside a dedicated BDR and marketing team, you’ll act as both a strategic hunter and trusted advisor, displacing legacy incumbents and transforming how companies empower their workforce. This is your chance to build a repeatable growth motion, win market share, and make a massive impact on our regional expansion! The Day-to-Day 📅 Spearhead Territory Growth: Build and execute an ambitious account plan across France, Belgium, and Luxembourg, targeting prime 1,000–5,000 employee mid-market accounts. Hunt Greenfield Opportunities: Drive proactive outbound pipeline generation, identifying whitespace and engaging key target accounts long before formal RFI/RFP processes begin. Partner for Success: Collaborate daily with your dedicated BDR and Marketing partners to run targeted ABM campaigns, craft sharp localized messaging, and convert high-quality leads into active opportunities. Master Full-Cycle Execution: Guide deals seamlessly from discovery through commercial close, translating complex customer challenges into compelling, ROI-driven business cases for senior executive stakeholders. Orchestrate Win Strategies: Act as the commercial quarterback, rallying cross-functional teams—including Solutions Consulting, Legal, Services, and Product—to deliver tailored demos, pitches, and flawless customer handovers. Outmaneuver the Competition: Position Docebo’s cutting-edge AI platform to clearly differentiate and win against legacy alternatives such as 360Learning, Rise Up, Bealink, Cegid/Talentsoft, and Cornerstone. Your Superpowers ⚡ Proven Track Record: Demonstrated success closing new business in B2B SaaS, with a history of hitting and exceeding quota in complex mid-market accounts. Relentless Hunter Mindset: Exceptional account-planning and pipeline-generation skills with an appetite for opening new doors and managing end-to-end sales cycles. Consultative Selling Mastery: Strong executive presence and the ability to build trust with senior L&D, HR, Talent, and C-level stakeholders while communicating measurable business value. Cross-Functional Leadership: Natural ability to rally internal teams—including BDRs, Marketing, Solutions Engineers, and Legal—into a cohesive, winning deal team. Operational Rigor: High CRM discipline, accurate forecasting skills, and a structured approach to mutual action plans and deal progression. Bilingual Expertise: Native French speaker with fluent professional English, giving you the confidence to navigate local market nuances and internal global collaboration seamlessly. Bonus Points 🌟 Regional Network: Existing relationships or prior experience collaborating with HR/EdTech integration partners, consultancies, and ecosystems across France and Benelux. Domain Knowledge: Direct experience selling Learning Management Systems (LMS), Learning Experience Platforms (LXP), or broader HR Tech/Workforce Intelligence solutions. Competitive Displacements: A proven track record of directly displacing legacy Learning and HR Tech platforms in competitive pitch scenarios. Our Hybrid Work Philosophy 🤝 Great work can happen anywhere but coming together helps us go further. Our team spends three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday) to collaborate, solve problems, and learn from each other. With flexibility the rest of the week, it’s a balance designed to help everyone do their best work and keep growing. Our Total Rewards Philosophy 🎉 Our Total Rewards Philosophy centers around three core areas to reward and care for our People: Rewarding Impact: We lead with competitive pay to reward the impact, skills and traits that fuel our success. Fostering Holistic Wellbeing: We care deeply about and invest in the whole person with programs that support our people’s physical, mental, and financial well-being. Empowering Our Talent Culture: We build a culture of trust and empowerment by designing our rewards and benefits with transparency, equity, and flexibility, enabling our people to do their best work and stay for the long haul. Our Promise to You 😍 Financial Wellness: Own a piece of Docebo through our Employee Share Purchase Plan (ESPP) at a 15% discount, plus a competitive compensation package. Your Well-Being, Covered: You’ll get access to health benefits, so you can get the care you need when you need it. Rest, Relax, Repeat: Rest and recharge with paid vacation days, two company-wide Docebo Days, floating holidays for cultural celebrations, and your birthday off! Family First : We provide coverage offering you time with your little one(s) so you can soak up all those precious moments. Fun fact: we had 30 Docebian babies join the family in 2025! Connections That Count: Connect with global communities through our Employee Resource Groups (including PRIDE, DWA, BIDOC, and Green Ambassadors) and company-wide events that keep the fun rolling all year long. About Docebo 💙 At Docebo, we create seamless, AI-powered learning experiences for over 3,000 customers worldwide. We have successfully achieved two IPOs ( TSX: DCBO & NASDAQ: DCBO ), been recognized as a top SaaS e-learning solution, and are growing exponentially in the process. We're a global company, with office across North America, EMEA, APAC, and beyond. Our team is guided by five core values— Grow Together Win Together, Build with Our Customer, Clear is Kind, Own Outcomes, Progress Over Perfection —that shape everything we do. If this resonates with you, now is the perfect time to join one of the fastest-growing learning technology companies in the world. Docebo is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer . We are committed to diversity and inclusion in our workforce. All qualified applicants and employees will receive consideration for employment regardless of their race, colour, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, genetic information, or any other category protected under applicable law. As a federal contractor, Docebo is committed to the principles of affirmative action and equal employment opportunity for protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Docebo does not discriminate because of protected veteran status or on the basis of disability, and Docebo takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. Any individuals requiring a reasonable accommodation or would like to voluntarily disclose a disability or protected veteran status to assist with their employment application should send an e-mail to their recruiter directly. title: Enterprise Core Sales Engineer - France
description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer at Samsara, you'll be splitting your time across two major focus areas; (1) supporting senior-level sellers in an attempt to grow existing customers, or win new customers, and (2) contributing to the SE Team as a senior resource. There is an expectation that an Enterprise SE is highly accountable for each technical sale, meaning that strong storytelling, objection handling, custom workarounds, advanced integrations, and extensive hands-on experience are requirements to win most deals. Takeaways from these activities should be shared across the SE Team via team meetings, messaging tools, etc. Additionally, an Enterprise Core Sales Engineer is accountable for carving out time to source and deliver product information, conduct testing of alpha products/features, manage projects, and build process improvements and automation that will scale the broader SE Team. A successful Enterprise Core Sales Engineer will possess excellent time management skills and will maintain a clear focus on retiring quota in addition to these other senior responsibilities. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in France.  This position requires travel up to 50% of the time. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment. You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.  You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.
