title: Director - Corporate, Issues & Crisis
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who we are:</strong></h3> <p>Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. With highly specialized teams, industry-leading technologies and breakthrough creative, we help brands and businesses redefine reputation as a competitive advantage so they can lead today and into the future. When you work at Burson, you are part of a global community of lifelong learners who thrive at the edge of innovation.</p> <p>WPP (LSE/NYSE: WPP) is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit <a href="WPP.com">WPP.com</a>&nbsp;</p> <p>For more information visit&nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/">bursonglobal.com</a> and follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/burson/posts/?feedView=all">LinkedIn</a> and&nbsp;<a href="https://www.instagram.com/burson.global/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.</p></div><p><strong>More about the role:</strong></p> <p>As a Director within our Corporate, Issues &amp; Crisis team, you will be a senior strategic advisor and team leader – protecting and enhancing the reputations of some of the world’s most significant organisations. Based in Amsterdam, you’ll lead high-stakes issues and crisis work across the Energy &amp; Industrials, Healthcare or Technology sectors, counselling senior clients through their most sensitive moments and delivering media training that builds their confidence and capability. You’ll grow existing relationships, win new business, and help build the visibility, reputation and talent of the team in the Netherlands.</p> <p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Take a leading role in developing Burson’s corporate, issues and crisis work in the Netherlands – retaining existing clients and growing new business</li> <li>Act as a trusted advisor and senior counsel to clients, adding strategic value during sensitive, high-stakes and reputational moments</li> <li>Lead issues and crisis programmes for clients across the Energy &amp; Industrials, Healthcare or Technology sectors, anticipating risks and building proactive response plans</li> <li>Design and deliver media training and crisis simulation exercises that build client confidence and capability</li> <li>Build the visibility and reputation of the team – with a view to winning new business and attracting talent</li> <li>Manage and mentor client teams, nurturing talent and contributing to a strong, collaborative team culture across the agency</li> <li>Take responsibility for budget monitoring, revenue forecasting, resourcing and fee negotiation to ensure the correct level of profitability</li> <li>Represent Burson externally in relevant specialist forums, network groups and speaker platforms across the Dutch and EU market</li> </ul> <p><strong>Experience that contributes to success:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven background leading corporate, issues and crisis management within both agency and in-house settings, with strong exposure to complex, high-stakes scenarios and strategic media relations.</li> <li>Sector expertise across either Energy &amp; Industrials, Healthcare or Technology with a strong understanding of the issues shaping these industries</li> <li>Experienced in designing and delivering media training and crisis simulation exercises, alongside wider reputation management initiatives</li> <li>Skilled in managing communications across a broad range of stakeholders – including media, government, employees, investors and consumers – during sensitive, high-pressure moments</li> <li>Commercially driven and entrepreneurial, with a track record of independently identifying and converting new business and managing client relationships end-to-end</li> <li>Trusted advisor to senior communications leaders and C-suite executives, with excellent interpersonal skills and credibility at the highest levels</li> <li>A strong, collaborative team leader, experienced in resourcing, commercial oversight and building high-performing, resilient teams, with previous experience within both agency and client-side environments.</li> <li>Full professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with the confidence to counsel clients and present in both languages</li> </ul> <p><strong>#LI-RE1</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>You belong at Burson:</strong></h3> <p>Our vision is for Burson to be the leading ‘academy company’ for creative communications professionals and emerging leaders. We provide a dynamic environment where ambitious colleagues come to elevate their skills, expand their networks, and ultimately, produce the best solutions for today’s leading brands. Our commitment to your growth is reflected in our robust benefits and people programs, which include professional development opportunities, mentorship programs with industry leaders, a vibrant and inclusive company culture fostering collaboration and innovation and packages designed to reward and retain top talent. We invest in our people because we believe their success is our success.</p> <p>At Burson, we’re an agency of learn-it-alls. We recognize that the things we do best, creativity and communications, require a level of nuanced understanding. That’s why it’s imperative for us to hire extraordinarily talented people of all backgrounds and identities. Without that we can’t do the essential work of inspiring bold ideas, fostering constructive dialogue, cultivating meaningful experiences, and driving innovation and creativity for our partners. Your unique point of view—your talent—is what makes you a #BursonPerson, and it’s how we deliver exceptional results for our clients, together.</p> <p>We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.</p> <p>When you click the "Submit Application" button below, this will send any information you add below to Burson. Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our &nbsp;<a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/recruitment-privacy-notice">Recruitment Privacy Policy. </a>California residents should read our <a href="https://www.bursonglobal.com/p/california-recruitment-privacy-notice">California Recruitment Privacy Notice. </a>This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.&nbsp;</p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

</ul> <h3><strong><u>Where You’ll Work&nbsp;</u></strong></h3> <p>This is a Netherlands-based role that will require 30% travel.</p> <h3><strong><u>Who You Are</u></strong></h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in title: Senior Director, HR - Field Operations (Europe)
description: <p></p> <h2><strong>About the role: What's in the Box</strong></h2> <p>We are seeking a highly strategic, operational, and empathetic <strong>Senior Director, Human Resources – Field Operations (Europe)</strong>. In this critical leadership role, you will serve as the principal HR Business Partner to the SVP of Europe Operations while providing strategic direction and mentorship to a distributed team of Site HR professionals across our European fulfillment centers.</p> <p>You will bridge the gap between high-level operational strategy and on-the-ground employee experience. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced, complex logistics or manufacturing environment, deeply understands European labor dynamics, and possesses the executive presence to challenge, coach, and partner with senior supply chain leaders.</p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do: The Recipe</strong></h2> <p><strong>Strategic Business Partnering</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the dedicated HR Business Partner and trusted advisor to the SVP, Europe Operations, aligning human capital strategy with broader business and operational goals.</li> <li>Drive organizational design, workforce planning, and change management initiatives across the European operations network to ensure scalable, efficient, and agile structures.</li> <li>Coach and guide senior operational leadership on talent density, performance management, succession planning, and inclusive leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Field HR Leadership &amp; Team Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of Site HR Managers, Directors, and HRBPs embedded within our local fulfillment centers across multiple European countries (e.g., Germany, UK, Netherlands, France, Sweden, and Norway).</li> <li>Foster a cohesive, collaborative HR community across the region, ensuring best-in-class HR service delivery, consistency in policy application, and a unified company culture.</li> <li>Establish clear KPIs and metrics for the Field HR team, utilizing data to track retention, engagement, and operational efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Labor Relations, Works Council &amp; Employee Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Architect a proactive employee relations strategy tailored to a blue-collar, high-volume operational workforce.</li> <li>Navigate complex European labor laws, partnering with local HR and legal teams to manage relationships with representation wherever applicable.&nbsp;</li> <li>Spearhead engagement and retention initiatives for frontline workers, ensuring a safe, inclusive, and rewarding workplace environment in our fulfillment centers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational HR Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with Centers of Excellence (Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, Shared Service) to build customized programs for Field Operations, including competitive hourly wage structures, peak-season hiring strategies, and frontline leadership training.</li> <li>Standardize and optimize core HR processes across European sites while respecting local nuances and compliance requirements.</li> <li>Champion HelloFresh’s data-driven culture by analyzing employee feedback, turnover data, and absenteeism trends to implement targeted interventions.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll bring: The Ingredients </strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> 12+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, with a minimum of 5 years leading HR functions in high-volume, multi-site Supply Chain, Fulfillment, Manufacturing, or Logistics environments.</li> <li><strong>Executive Partnering:</strong> Proven track record of operating as a strategic HRBP to C-suite or SVP-level operations leaders, with the ability to influence without authority and drive systemic change.</li> <li><strong>Pan-European Expertise:</strong> Deep understanding of European labor laws, compliance standards, and significant experience negotiating and collaborating with Works Councils and trade unions.</li> <li><strong>Leadership:</strong> Exceptional team leadership skills with experience managing, scaling, and empowering remote/distributed HR teams.</li> <li><strong>Analytical Acumen:</strong> A heavily data-driven approach to HR. You rely on metrics and analytics to identify root causes, build business cases, and measure the success of people initiatives.</li> <li><strong>Agility &amp; Resilience:</strong> Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, and dynamic environment where ambiguity is common and speed is critical.</li> <li><strong>Languages:</strong> Business fluency in English is required; proficiency in an additional European language (e.g., German, Dutch, French) is highly preferred.</li> </ul> <p></p> <h2><strong>What we offer: The Toppings</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Shape the future of food:</strong> Play a key role in transforming how millions of people eat as we grow into a global food solutions company.</li> <li><strong>Drive transformational change:</strong> Your decisions will have a direct and immediate impact, helping to shape strategy, scale teams, and redefine leadership in a rapidly evolving business.</li> <li><strong>Build a global brand:</strong> Create deeper, more sustainable connections with our customers, putting them at the heart of every decision.</li> <li><strong>Benefit from long-term wealth creation:</strong> Your compensation is heavily weighted toward equity, directly aligning your personal success with the company's future through our Virtual Stock Option (VSO) and Restricted Stock Unit (RSU) plans.</li> <li><strong>Thrive in a high-performance environment:</strong> Work with ambitious, intellectually curious peers on a global scale, enjoying an environment built for empowerment and speed.</li> </ul> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><em>Important: For this position, it is essential that you have a good command of the Dutch language, both written and spoken.</em></p> <p><strong>WPP Media </strong></p> <p>WPP Media is het wereldwijde mediacollectief van WPP, volledig gebouwd voor het AI-tijdperk. We bundelen het beste platform, de meest getalenteerde mensen en de sterkste partners om innovatieve oplossingen te creëren. Ons doel? Merken elke dag ongeëvenaarde groei bieden. Dit fundament vinden we in onze gedeelde kernwaarden:</p> <ul> <li><strong>We’re Extraordinary:</strong>&nbsp;We verleggen grenzen, dagen het gewone denken uit en doorbreken de status-quo in ons streven naar innovatie en groei.</li> <li><strong>We’re Open:</strong>&nbsp;We bouwen vertrouwen en begrip door naadloos samen te werken – met onze teams, klanten en partners.</li> <li><strong>We’re Optimistic:</strong>&nbsp;Een 'growth mindset' zit in ons DNA. We omarmen verandering als dé manier om het beste uit onszelf te halen.</li> </ul> <p>Binnen WPP Media zijn wij het creatie team dat digitale campagnes nét dat beetje extra geeft. We mixen media, creativiteit en technologie om ideeën te maken die opvallen, raken en blijven hangen. Geen standaard banners of vluchtige clicks, maar slimme, opvallende en vaak verrassende creaties die écht aandacht trekken. Van interactieve formats tot dynamische campagnes: we zorgen dat merken niet alleen zichtbaar zijn, maar ook een glimlach, klik of wow-moment verdienen. Kortom – wij maken digitale media leuker, slimmer en effectiever.</p> <p><strong>Senior Project Manager<br></strong>Bij ons draait alles om creatieve impact. En om dat vlekkeloos te laten verlopen, zoeken we een&nbsp;<strong>Senior Project Manager </strong>die energie krijgt van regelen, structureren én inspireren. Iemand die het creatieve proces strak organiseert, maar ook snapt dat de mooiste ideeën juist ontstaan als er ruimte is om te spelen.<br><br>Als Senior Project Manager Creative ben jij de spil tussen klant, jouw eigen creatie team en mediaspecialisten. Voor jouw klanten ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt: je denkt mee, geeft advies en zorgt dat ideeën werkelijkheid worden.</p> <p><strong>Wat ga je concreet doen?</strong></p> <ul> <li>Je organiseert en bewaakt het projectplan van A tot Z, inclusief scope, deadlines en deliverables.</li> <li>Je zorgt voor <strong>heldere projectstructuren</strong> en planning voor alle disciplines.</li> <li>Je bent hét centrale aanspreekpunt voor klanten, interne teams en externe partners.</li> <li>Je vertaalt creatieve en commerciële briefing naar&nbsp;<strong>uitvoerbare plannen</strong> en bewaakt verwachtingen.</li> <li>Je identificeert risico’s vroegtijdig en zorgt dat issues worden opgelost voordat ze impact hebben.</li> <li>Je bewaakt scopes, kwaliteitscriteria en KPI’s, en rapporteert hierover.</li> <li>Je draagt bij aan verbeterde workflows, tools en werkwijzen zodat het team nog efficiënter werkt.</li> <li>Je fungeert als brug tussen creatie, media en operations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wie ben jij?</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Sterke projectmanager</strong> met min. 5+ jaar ervaring in rollen die draaien om planning, coördinatie, organisatie en procesoptimalisatie.</li> <li>Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het managen van complexe projecten (in agencies, techteams, productteams of andere uitvoerende omgevingen).</li> <li>Je bent een pro in overzicht houden, risico’s inschatten en structureel werken — en je weet dit zelfverzekerd te vertalen naar teams en klanten.</li> <li>Je hebt <strong>geen creatieve productie-achtergrond nodig</strong> (zoals design of copywriting); wat telt is jouw vermogen om projecten tot een goed einde te brengen.</li> <li>Voorkeur voor ervaring met middelenbegrotingen, resource-planning en KPI-gestuurde workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wat bieden wij jou?</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Salaris:</strong>&nbsp;€<strong>3000 – 4250 bruto per maand</strong>&nbsp;(op basis van <strong>38,75 uur per</strong> week) afhankelijk van ervaring, leeftijd en senioriteit.</li> <li><strong>Flexibiliteit:</strong>&nbsp;Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken, flexibele werktijden én zelfs voor een tijdje in het buitenland (EU).</li> <li><strong>Vrijheid: </strong>Veel eigen verantwoordelijk om je eigen rol en werkdag in te vullen.</li> <li><strong>Werkomgeving: </strong>werken in een goed georganiseerde creatieve omgeving met een enthousiast team van creatieven, projectmanagers en mediaspecialisten.</li> <li><strong>Klanten:</strong> Werken voor A merken van Nederland en internationaal op projecten waar je écht trots op kunt zijn en die zichtbaar impact maken.</li> <li><strong>Groeikansen</strong>:&nbsp;Volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling in een innovatief en dynamisch team, met een focus op AI-transformatie.</li> <li><strong>Toegang tot M Academy:</strong>&nbsp;Voor uitgebreide trainingen en workshops in zowel&nbsp;hard als soft skills, inclusief specifieke AI-trainingen.</li> <li><strong>Reiskostenvergoeding:</strong>&nbsp;Reiskosten worden volledig vergoed.</li> <li><strong>8% vakantiegeld&nbsp;en&nbsp;26 vakantiedagen&nbsp;per jaar</strong> (plus 9 extra bij te kopen!).</li> <li><strong>Hybrid Working allowance:</strong>&nbsp;<strong>€30 netto</strong> per maand bij fulltime.</li> <li><strong>Bring Your Own Device (BYOD):</strong>&nbsp;Je ontvangt een maandelijkse telefoonvergoeding van <strong>€57,50 netto</strong>.</li> <li><strong>Lunchfaciliteiten:</strong>&nbsp;Voordelige lunch in de kantine en een barista voor verse koffie.</li> <li><strong>Zorgverzekering:</strong>&nbsp;Profiteer van onze collectieve zorgverzekering<strong>.</strong></li> </ul> <p>Geen dag is hier hetzelfde! Het ene moment duik je in een briefing met een klant, het volgende moment ben je met een creative bezig om een campagne pixel-perfect te krijgen. Je werkt met verschillende disciplines, klanten en uitdagingen, waardoor je continu leert en groeit. En jij bent degene die ervoor zorgt dat alles klopt.</p> <p>Enthousiast? Laat van je horen en vertel ons waarom jij de Project Manager Creative bent die wij zoeken.<strong>&nbsp;</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

As Senior AI Solution Specialist at Sunweb Group, you take the lead on our more complex AI initiatives. You turn ambiguous business challenges into working prototypes and scalable solutions, while actively building, configuring and testing those solutions yourself.

You’ll join our five-person Architecture team and work closely with the AI PMO, connecting business teams with architecture, product, engineering, data and security.

This is a hands-on senior technical role, not a purely strategic, architectural or people-management position. Seniority here means tackling more complex challenges, having greater autonomy and impact, and helping others grow. We’re looking for someone who has recent practical experience building technical solutions and wants to continue doing so. You’ll design, prototype, configure, integrate and build, while also providing technical direction when needed.

Location: Rotterdam (Hybrid – 50% in office)
Start Date: January/February 2027

Availability: Fulltime

Your impact

  • Lead complex AI discovery
    Turn unclear, cross-functional or strategically important business challenges into concrete AI opportunities. Take them from problem definition and validation through to a working prototype.

  • Build AI solutions yourself
    Design, develop, configure and test agents, assistants and automated workflows that connect different departments, data sources and systems. You won’t only define what should be built or hand it over to others. You’ll be actively involved in building it.

  • Shape enterprise AI initiatives
    Identify when an AI solution needs to move beyond experimentation into a business-critical or customer-facing product, and work with product and engineering teams to make that transition successful.

  • Design for production
    Define solution architecture, integrations and non-functional requirements, while considering scalability, security, supportability, cost and business value.

  • Create reusable AI patterns
    Develop approaches for grounding, identity, integration, monitoring and evaluation that can be reused across teams, and identify opportunities for shared AI capabilities.

  • Coach and challenge others
    Review solutions, share technical expertise and coach colleagues and business users. You’ll work closely with our AI Solution Specialist and help raise the quality of AI solutions across Sunweb Group, while remaining an active builder yourself.

  • Strengthen responsible AI
    Contribute to our AI framework and guardrails, promote responsible use of AI and help create visibility around our AI initiatives.

Who you are

You’re curious, pragmatic and comfortable navigating ambiguity. You combine strong technical judgement with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

You know the difference between an impressive AI demo and a solution that creates measurable business value. You enjoy working independently, bringing different perspectives together and sharing what you learn along the way.

Most importantly, you’re a builder. You enjoy getting hands-on with technology, experimenting, developing prototypes and turning ideas into working solutions. You may have led technical initiatives, defined architecture or coached others, but you haven’t moved away from building things yourself, and you don’t want to.

What you bring

Must-haves

  • A proven track record of delivering complex AI, automation, integration, data or cloud solutions

  • Strong solution design skills across applications, APIs, identity, data, integrations and cloud services

  • Experience taking ambiguous business problems from discovery through prototyping, testing and solution design

  • Experience defining architecture options, non-functional requirements and production readiness

  • The ability to translate between business needs and technical possibilities

  • Confidence working with business leaders, architects, product owners and engineers

  • Strong technical leadership skills, with the ability to review, challenge and coach others without stepping away from hands-on delivery

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with RAG, embeddings, vector search and enterprise knowledge solutions

  • Experience with REST APIs, JSON, webhooks, OAuth, connectors and/or MCP

  • Development or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, C# or PowerShell

  • Experience working with AI agents, assistants or orchestration workflows

  • Experience in the travel or tourism industry

Our technology

Our AI and technology landscape includes Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Power Platform, Power Automate, Teams, SharePoint, Microsoft Graph, Azure AI services, Microsoft Foundry, ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, MCP, Entra ID and Git.

Operating in eight international markets, we cater to all travelers through our brands, Sunweb and ‘Eliza Was Here.’ With a team of 600 colleagues and operational hubs in Rotterdam, Girona, Paris, Copenhagen, Stockholm, Antwerp, Chambéry, and Zurich, we deliver seamless, high-quality holiday experiences at competitive prices. Je bent in staat informatie uit verschillende werkstromen samen te brengen tot een helder totaalbeeld. title: Data Analyst - Logistics
description: Maybe you call yourself a Data Specialist, a BI Consultant, a "why-does-this-number-not-match-their-Excel" specialist… or maybe you just call yourself Sam. Whatever you call yourself: we're bringing a whole group of container terminals onto one data platform, and you will help us do that in the best way by getting to know how the container terminals work and how their data is shaped. Over time, you'll become the person everyone turns to when they need to understand a terminal and its data. What you get  A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience.  €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.  25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.  Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.  €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.  A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then.  Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We will consider remote candidates too. We use salary zones, so the range may be lower elsewhere in Europe. If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands, the salary range will be shared before your first interview. Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR.  About us  All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities.    What the job looks like  Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems. Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team. Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source. Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal. Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history. What you bring  Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told. Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too. Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job. Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time. Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge . You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards. AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do. Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus. Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus. Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.   We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.  Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Whatever you call yourself: we're bringing a whole group of container terminals onto one data platform, and you will help us do that in the best way by getting to know how the container terminals work and how their data is shaped. Over time, you'll become the person everyone turns to when they need to understand a terminal and its data.

What you get 

  • A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience. 

  • €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it. 

  • 25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months. 

  • Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings. 

  • €500 home-office budget and a great laptop. 

  • A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then. 

  • Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We will consider remote candidates too. We use salary zones, so the range may be lower elsewhere in Europe. If you are applying from outside of the Netherlands, the salary range will be shared before your first interview.

Benefits across the EU: the perks above are AYBI's and go to everyone, everywhere. Statutory benefits (pension, health, social security, leave, sick pay, notice) follow the hire's country via their local contract or EOR. 

About us 

All Your BI is a remote-first data agency based in Rotterdam. Since 2019 we've grown from a boutique consultancy into an international data team of more than 60 data heroes spread across Europe. We deliver managed BI services for logistics and industrial companies, helping reduce data waste and move businesses forward. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities. 

 
What the job looks like 

  • Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems.

  • Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team.

  • Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source.

  • Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal.

  • Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history.


What you bring 

  • Attitude and execution: You bring energy and curiosity, along with the discipline to follow things through and close every loop. You know when to speak directly with the terminal operators to solve a challenge, take ownership of finding answers, and understand what the numbers mean for the business without having to be told.

  • Experience: At least 4 years of experience working in a data analyst role, with a track record of taking on increasingly complex challenges. Candidates with more experience are welcome too.

  • Business context: You've worked in an operations or logistics team (or another asset-heavy environment), so you understand how operational businesses work, what questions to ask and why assumptions shouldn't be taken as facts. Experience in a container terminal environment is a big plus, but the rest you learn on the job.

  • Data model literacy: You're not a data engineer, but you're technically confident enough to read and understand a data model, distinguish a modelling problem from a source-data problem, and understand how different data sources connect to test a hypothesis and how metrics behave over time.

  • Reconciliation: You have strong SQL skills and at least basic Python knowledge. You've helped teams bring complex information from different sources together, investigate discrepancies and explain what the numbers mean in plain language. You've used Power BI or a similar tool mainly to explore, check and validate data, rather than to build polished dashboards.

  • AI with a quality radar: You know how to make AI work for you and others, and can judge when it makes sense to use it and when it doesn't. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do.

  • Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus.

  • Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus.

  • Nice to have: Experience with Microsoft Fabric or Databricks.

 
We're a growing team across Europe, and we hire to widen that mix, not narrow it. What matters is what you can do and the perspective you bring, not your age, gender, ethnicity, orientation, disability, background, or where you studied. If the role excites you and you bring most of it, apply: the people who add the most rarely tick every box.

How we hire, how we grow, what it feels like to be here. That's why we need someone who doesn't just manage HR, but shapes culture intentionally.

Your Goal: Own the Full Employee Journey

As our Senior HR Business Partner, you'll take everything we've built so far and make it your own. From how we attract new colleagues, to how our people grow, reward and support the ones already here. 

You will:

  • Run the full employee lifecycle end-to-end: attraction, recruitment (with budget for external support on specialised roles), onboarding, development, performance, engagement and offboarding.

  • Be the go-to person for managers and employees on any people-related question, big or small

  • Keep our career growth framework relevant as the organisation evolves

  • Make sure our salaries stay fair and aligned with the market

  • Keep us compliant, without slowing us down

  • Be a genuine sounding board for the CEO and the Executive Team on people topics

  • Own internal communication. Make sure everyone understands where we're going, why, and what it means for them and their team 

  • Turn signals from the organisation into clear input for the Executive Team

Shape how it feels to work here

Talk360 is doing well, and we want that to show in how it feels to work here. You will:

  • Organise the team activities, outings and moments that make people want to stick around, and genuinely enjoy doing it

  • Bring energy to the day-to-day, not just to the big projects

Team

You're the only HR person and you report straight to the CEO, which means People & Culture has genuine influence on how we build this company.

We have an international diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond. You'll work closely with everyone, from support to product to leadership, and you'll actually see your impact as we grow and mature.


What you bring

  • 5+ years of HR experience across the full employee lifecycle, ideally in a start-up or scale-up. You've either been there and done that and want to do it again at a purpose-driven company, or you're a fast-growing medior who is ready to grow as fast as we do 

  • Comfortable running day-to-day HR operations as well as owning larger, more complex projects

  • Recruitment experience/exposure 

  • Experience with career frameworks, compensation benchmarking (we use Figures) is a plus

  • High energy and a genuine interest in creating a great place to work

  • Business acumen, you understand you are helping us to create a high-performing organization

  • Strong internal communication skills: you can make complex things clear, in writing and in person, for a multicultural audience 

Who you are

  • Not afraid to challenge the status quo, including challenging the Executive Team

  • As happy organising a team outing as solving a tricky HR cases

  • A trusted sparring partner for managers and employees

  • Curious, hands-on and pragmatic

  • Comfortable working with a multicultural hybrid team setup across time zones
     

What you get

Competitive compensation

  • 65,000 – 85,000 gross per year, all in.  

  • Option to work 32 hours a week.

Learning and growth

  • €1,500 annual personal development budget, plus access to company-wide training sessions to keep learning and evolving. 

Time to recharge 

  • 25 vacation days 

  • Option to swap two public holidays per year for days that better reflect your culture or beliefs 

  • Recharge Fridays, unlocked when team targets are met (we'll tell you more during the interview) 

Work from anywhere

  • As a global and diverse team, we encourage you to work from another city or country for up to 2 weeks per year, gain fresh perspectives and spark new ideas. 

A team you'll actually want to be part of 

  • Weekly team lunch every Thursday 

  • Regular team moments and outings 

  • An international and diverse team, with colleagues from the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine and beyond 

Set up for success 

  • Company laptop and all the tools you need to do your best work 

  • Monthly phone allowance and commuting allowance 

An environment to grow and make impact

  • A collaborative environment where you can learn from others, take ownership, and contribute to a meaningful mission

About Talk360

Talk360 was founded with a clear purpose: to become the most accessible and reliable calling app for African diaspora communities, both within Africa and abroad. For our users, calls are not transactional, they are emotional lifelines to family, friends, and essential support networks. When service quality drops, they feel it immediately. That responsibility drives everything we build.

Over the past years, Talk360 has grown into a global communications platform connecting more than 6 million people worldwide last year. We successfully spun off our payments arm into NjiaPay, stepped into the gap left by the discontinuation of Skype, and achieved profitable growth from 2025 onwards, marking our transition from early-stage scale-up to a disciplined, sustainable business.

As we continue to grow, we are expanding beyond our own B2C app. We are now launching our first embedded calling products within partner platforms, bringing Talk360’s technology into new ecosystems and enabling partners to offer international calling directly within their own products.

Our ambition is bold: to become the world’s most trusted way to call any real phone number — connecting migrants, travellers, professionals, and businesses across the globe.

title: Interim Payments & Operations Senior Specialist - Freelance Assignment
description: Freelance Assignment 4 January to 30 April 2027 5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays) Reporting to COO The Challenge Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation. Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through. We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Ewan, who runs our ops today and payments, is away from mid January to mid April on paternity leave. The assignment runs 4 January to 30 April. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch. What You'll Do Keep things running Keep ops moving: Take over the daily ops Ewan runs today: monitoring and alerts, Support escalations, incidents, and the automations behind them. Know who repairs each one when it breaks. Run verification: Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips. Go deep on payments Get up to speed: Learn how payments works for Talk360 fast, starting from Ewan's existing work: NjiaPay, our payment orchestrator, and our PSPs (Adyen, PayPal, Startbutton, Paystack, Ozow and more). Then go deep where it moves conversion and cost most. Fix it weekly: Watch authorisation, 3DS and decline rates, and hold the balance between chargebacks and payment friction, including the fraud rules that move both. Catch drops early, find the cause and fix it together with our providers' account managers. Create order: By the end of April, hand Ewan a payments operating model (who owns what across Ops, Product and Finance, the KPIs, the weekly and monthly rhythm) and a prioritised plan he can execute. What You'll Bring Must have 5+ years in payments at a high-volume consumer business (fintech, e-commerce, or similar), with both a strategic and a hands-on side. Hands-on experience with payment providers such as Adyen and PayPal: authorisation rates, 3DS / SCA, chargebacks and disputes. Hands-on experience with fraud rules, ideally Adyen risk rules: you can judge what a rule change does to chargebacks and to conversion. Active, daily use of AI and automation tools. You don't need to build automations, but you can read, run and triage them (we use n8n and Claude skills). A track record of turning a messy area into an operating model: owners, KPIs, rhythm and a plan others can execute. You pick things up fast and learn fast: you are productive in a new area within days, not weeks. Nice to have Payments in emerging markets such as Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana or Kenya: bank transfers, mobile money, local providers. Experience with OTP or verification performance and cost. Experience with Omni dashboards. Who You Are Strategic and hands-on: You can think about where our payments set-up should go in the morning and fix a failing provider flow by lunch. An owner: You pick up a seat that isn't yours after about two weeks of handover and run it without needing a brief, then hand it back in better shape than you found it. Orderly: You write down what you decided and why, so the next person doesn't have to guess. A bridge between teams: You work easily between Finance, Product, Support and external providers, and you explain things clearly in written English. raw.description:
Freelance Assignment
4 January to 30 April 2027
5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays)
Reporting to COO

The Challenge

Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. A parent back home. An important work call to close the deal. When a payment fails, the call never happens. It's not a checkout glitch; it's a missed conversation.

Payments at Talk360 is not simple. Our callers pay with cards, wallets and local bank transfers, through different providers in different markets, from the Netherlands to Nigeria, South Africa and Ghana. Every provider, method and market behaves a little differently, and a small shift in authorisation or decline rates is real money and real people not getting through.

We're a lean company of around 30 people, profitable since 2025, and growing beyond our core app into calling for work and embedded calling for partners. Ewan, who runs our ops today and payments, is away from mid January to mid April on paternity leave. The assignment runs 4 January to 30 April. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch.

What You'll Do

Keep things running

  • Keep ops moving: Take over the daily ops Ewan runs today: monitoring and alerts, Support escalations, incidents, and the automations behind them. Know who repairs each one when it breaks.

  • Run verification: Own verification (OTP) performance and cost: weekly conversion and failure review, a monthly cost check, and follow-up with Product and Tech when something slips.

Go deep on payments

  • Get up to speed: Learn how payments works for Talk360 fast, starting from Ewan's existing work: NjiaPay, our payment orchestrator, and our PSPs (Adyen, PayPal, Startbutton, Paystack, Ozow and more). Then go deep where it moves conversion and cost most.

  • Fix it weekly: Watch authorisation, 3DS and decline rates, and hold the balance between chargebacks and payment friction, including the fraud rules that move both. Catch drops early, find the cause and fix it together with our providers' account managers.

  • Create order: By the end of April, hand Ewan a payments operating model (who owns what across Ops, Product and Finance, the KPIs, the weekly and monthly rhythm) and a prioritised plan he can execute.


What You'll Bring

Must have

  • 5+ years in payments at a high-volume consumer business (fintech, e-commerce, or similar), with both a strategic and a hands-on side.

  • Hands-on experience with payment providers such as Adyen and PayPal: authorisation rates, 3DS / SCA, chargebacks and disputes.

  • Hands-on experience with fraud rules, ideally Adyen risk rules: you can judge what a rule change does to chargebacks and to conversion.

  • Active, daily use of AI and automation tools. You don't need to build automations, but you can read, run and triage them (we use n8n and Claude skills).

  • A track record of turning a messy area into an operating model: owners, KPIs, rhythm and a plan others can execute.

  • You pick things up fast and learn fast: you are productive in a new area within days, not weeks.

Nice to have

  • Payments in emerging markets such as Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana or Kenya: bank transfers, mobile money, local providers.

  • Experience with OTP or verification performance and cost.

  • Experience with Omni dashboards.

Who You Are

  • Strategic and hands-on: You can think about where our payments set-up should go in the morning and fix a failing provider flow by lunch.

  • An owner: You pick up a seat that isn't yours after about two weeks of handover and run it without needing a brief, then hand it back in better shape than you found it.

  • Orderly: You write down what you decided and why, so the next person doesn't have to guess.

  • A bridge between teams: You work easily between Finance, Product, Support and external providers, and you explain things clearly in written English.

  • Invested in the person on the other end: You see a failed payment as someone who couldn't call home, and that makes you want to fix it properly.
